Apply on the SAMAST portal with caste certificate, Aadhaar, PAN and Samagra ID.
items.onlyText: Only Scheduled Caste entrepreneurs aged 18 to 45

items.name: Bhagwan Birsa Munda Swarojgar Yojana (ST entrepreneurs)
items.summary: Bank loan of ₹1-50 lakh for ST entrepreneurs with 5% a year interest subsidy and guarantee fee paid for up to 7 years
details: Loans of ₹1 lakh to ₹50 lakh for manufacturing units and ₹1 lakh to ₹25 lakh for service and trade units.
Interest subsidy of 5% a year (or the actual rate if lower) on term and working-capital loans, plus the bank guarantee fee at the prevailing rate, for up to 7 years including moratorium.
Run by the MP Tribal Finance and Development Corporation (Tribal Affairs Department); approved by the MP cabinet on 6 Sep 2022.
conditions: Scheduled Tribe resident of Madhya Pradesh, aged 18 to 45, at least Class 8 pass; family annual income up to ₹12 lakh.
Not a bank defaulter and not already assisted under another government self-employment scheme; benefit once only.
Interest subsidy is paid only while the loan is repaid regularly.
Apply online on the MP SAMAST portal.
items.onlyText: Only for Scheduled Tribe entrepreneurs of Madhya Pradesh aged 18 to 45

items.name: Tantya Mama Arthik Kalyan Yojana (ST micro-business loans)
items.summary: Bank loan of ₹10,000 to ₹1 lakh for ST entrepreneurs with 7% a year interest subsidy for up to 5 years
details: Loans of ₹10,000 to ₹1 lakh for any self-employment activity (manufacturing, service or trade).
Interest subsidy of 7% a year on the outstanding loan and the bank guarantee fee at the prevailing rate, for up to 5 years including moratorium.
Run by the MP Tribal Finance and Development Corporation; approved by the MP cabinet on 6 Sep 2022.
conditions: Scheduled Tribe resident of Madhya Pradesh aged 18 to 55 who is not an income-tax payer.
Not a bank defaulter and not already assisted under another government self-employment scheme; benefit once only.
Apply online on the MP SAMAST portal.
items.onlyText: Only for Scheduled Tribe residents of Madhya Pradesh aged 18 to 55 who do not pay income tax

items.name: MP Garment, Apparel, Footwear, Toys and Accessories Policy 2025 – MSME employment assistance
items.summary: 25% of each new regular employee's salary, up to ₹2,500/month and ₹5 lakh/year per unit, for 5 years
details: For MSME apparel and made-up units with ₹1 crore to ₹5 crore in plant and machinery and at least 25 regular employees.

Policy also offers 50% infrastructure assistance (up to ₹5 crore), 50% green/ETP subsidy, and 100% IPR filing reimbursement (up to ₹10 lakh); larger garment and footwear units get ₹5,000 per employee per month and 5% interest subsidy.
conditions: Sector: ready-made garments/made-ups, footwear, garment/footwear accessories and toys (NIC 14, 15, 32); tanneries excluded
Employees must be permanent residents of Madhya Pradesh
Apply through MPIDC / Invest MP portal

items.name: MP Agri, Dairy and Food Processing Policy 2025 – mandi fee and production incentives
items.summary: 100% mandi fee reimbursement for 5 years; 1% of turnover for 5 years (up to ₹5 crore); 50% quality certification up to ₹5 lakh
details: Mandi fee on agri-produce bought for processing is reimbursed for 5 years or up to 50% of plant and machinery investment, whichever is lower.
Production-linked incentive of 1% of annual net sales for 5 years, capped at ₹5 crore.
Power tariff reimbursement of ₹1 per unit for 5 years; 50% (up to ₹5 crore) infrastructure and green (ETP) assistance; organic certification 100% up to ₹5 lakh.
Food processing units above ₹10 crore get 1.5 times the basic investment promotion assistance.
conditions: Sector: food and agro processing that transforms or adds value to farm produce (NIC 10, 11); plain grading, sorting or packing units excluded
Apply through MPIDC / Invest MP portal

items.name: MP Tourism Policy 2025: capital subsidy for hotels, resorts and heritage hotels
items.summary: 15% capital subsidy: up to Rs 50 lakh for a new standard hotel or mini resort (min Rs 2 crore), up to Rs 5 crore for larger units
details: New standard hotel (25+ AC rooms) or mini resort (10+ rooms) with at least Rs 2 crore investment: 15% subsidy up to Rs 50 lakh.
New deluxe or 3-star-plus hotel or resort (50+ rooms, min Rs 10 crore): 15% up to Rs 5 crore. Heritage hotel under proprietorship (min Rs 3 crore): 15% up to Rs 2 crore.
Expansion of an existing hotel or resort (min Rs 1 crore, staying capacity up by at least 50%): 15% up to Rs 5 crore.
Projects below Rs 10 crore can get the subsidy in one go or in instalments linked to project stages.
items.extraFor: Extra 5% of project cost for projects in backward or difficult areas and for SC/ST entrepreneurs
conditions: Unit must run for at least 3 years after getting the subsidy, or the subsidy may be recovered
Apply within one year to the MP Tourism Department / MP Tourism Board

items.name: MP IT, ITeS and ESDM Investment Promotion Policy 2023: rent and employment assistance
items.summary: Rent aid up to Rs 3,000 per seat per month for 3 years, and Rs 4,000 per employee per month employment assistance for 3 years
details: Rental assistance for units in co-working or plug-and-play space: up to Rs 3,000 per seat per month depending on district category, for 3 years, cap Rs 10 crore per unit.
Employment Generation Assistance: Rs 4,000 per employee per month (up to 1,000 employees), for 3 years, cap Rs 15 crore per unit.
conditions: For IT, ITeS, BPO/BPM and ESDM units starting or expanding in MP during the policy period
Rent aid needs at least 20 seats; employment aid needs at least 20 EPF-registered employees and 60 sq ft per employee
Apply to MP State Electronics Development Corporation (MPSEDC)
apply: MPSEDC / Department of Science and Technology, MP

items.name: Dr. Bhimrao Ambedkar Kamdhenu Yojana (dairy units of 25 cattle)
items.summary: 25% capital subsidy (33% for SC/ST) on dairy units of 25 milch animals costing up to ₹42 lakh per unit
details: One unit is 25 cows or buffaloes of a single breed, with project cost up to ₹42 lakh; an applicant can set up several units, up to 200 animals.
Subsidy of 25% (33% for SC/ST) is paid as a lump sum after a three-year lock-in; the rest is financed by a bank loan.
items.extraFor: 33% subsidy for SC/ST applicants (25% for others)
conditions: Applicant aged 21 or above with at least 3.5 acres of land per unit and completed dairy training.
Priority for those already supplying milk to dairy unions or on milk collection routes.
Apply through the MP Animal Husbandry and Dairy Department.
apply: MP Animal Husbandry and Dairy Department (district office)

items.name: Madhya Pradesh Startup Policy and Implementation Scheme 2022 (amended Feb 2024)
items.summary: Investment assistance 15% up to Rs 15 lakh, lease rent 50% up to Rs 5,000/month, patent support up to Rs 5 lakh
details: Investment assistance of 15% of investment raised from a SEBI/RBI-recognised institution, up to Rs 15 lakh.
Lease rental support of 50% of monthly workspace rent, up to Rs 5,000 per month for three years.
Patent assistance up to Rs 5 lakh for patents obtained by a startup in the state.
Event participation: 75% reimbursement, up to Rs 50,000 (domestic) or Rs 1.5 lakh (international), one event a year and two in total.
Startups are exempt from prior experience and turnover conditions in state tenders up to Rs 1 crore.
items.extraFor: Women-led and SC/ST startups: investment assistance of 18%, up to Rs 18 lakh per stage and Rs 72 lakh over four stages.
conditions: DPIIT-recognised startup registered and operating in Madhya Pradesh.
Apply through the MP Startup Centre / Department of MSME portal.

states.short: Maharashtra Industries, Investment and Services Policy 2025
states.statusText: In force. The new Package Scheme of Incentives that puts it into effect has not been issued yet, so claims may still follow PSI-2019; confirm with the DIC.

portal.label: MAITRI single window; MSME claims go through the District Industries Centre

states.zones: Rates depend on the taluka group, from A (most developed) to D and D+ (least). Vidarbha, Marathwada, Ratnagiri, Sindhudurg, Jalgaon and Dhule, and No-Industry, Naxal-affected and Aspirational districts get higher caps. The DIC confirms your taluka's group.
states.notes: Uses the Udyam size limits. Total state incentives are capped at 100% of fixed capital investment. Alcohol and tobacco units are excluded, and textile units have a separate policy.

items.name: Industrial Promotion Subsidy (IPS)
items.summary: Refund of 100% gross SGST on sales within Maharashtra, capped at 30%-100% of fixed capital investment by zone.
details: Cap (% of FCI)/years: A 30%/5; B 40%/7; C 50%/7; D 60%/10; D+ 70%/10; Vidarbha, Marathwada, Ratnagiri, Sindhudurg, Jalgaon, Dhule 80%/10; No-Industry, Naxal-affected, Aspirational districts 100%/10. One secondary source says food processing, green energy and Industry 4.0 units get +20% cap and 2 extra years.
items.extraFor: Women/SC/ST: see the additional incentive entry
conditions: Only SGST on the first sale within Maharashtra counts
Eligibility Certificate required
One secondary source says expansion/diversification gets 75% of new-unit caps
Captive power plant investment excluded

items.name: Capital subsidy (thrust/priority sectors only)
items.summary: 20% of eligible fixed capital investment for thrust-sector units, capped at ₹25 crore (₹5 crore a year).
details: Share of machinery cost counted: 50% in A/B, 80% in C, 100% in D/D+. One secondary source says general (non-thrust) manufacturing gets no capital subsidy.
conditions: Thrust/priority sector list unconfirmed (sources cite pharma, EV, aerospace, food processing, electronics)

items.name: Interest subsidy
items.summary: Up to 5% a year interest subsidy on term loans, capped at ₹1 crore per year.
details: The unit must itself bear at least 5% interest. Zones and duration unconfirmed. One secondary source says Group C onwards only, with A/B eligible only above 1,000 employees.
conditions: Term loans for fixed capital

items.name: Stamp duty exemption
items.summary: 100% stamp duty exemption in Groups C, D, D+ and below; 50% on the first deed in A/B.
details: A/B: 50% waiver on the first lease or conveyance deed. C, D, D+ and special areas: 100% exemption for new and eligible units.
conditions: Eligibility Certificate required

items.name: Electricity duty exemption
items.summary: 100% electricity duty exemption during the incentive period in Groups C, D, D+ and below.
details: C, D, D+ and below: new or eligible expansion units, for the incentive tenure. A/B: only export-oriented units and units fully owned by women, SC/ST or persons with disabilities that employ 50% of their workforce from that group.
items.extraFor: In A/B areas, only units fully owned by women, SC/ST or persons with disabilities (with 50% workforce from the group) qualify
conditions: Tenure follows the incentive eligibility period

items.name: Power tariff subsidy
items.summary: ₹1 per unit power tariff subsidy for 3 years, capped at ₹1 crore per MSME, in Groups D, D+ and below.
details: These figures are from Grant Thornton. Another secondary source says Group C onwards for 5 years. The conflict is unresolved until the implementing scheme is issued.

items.name: EPF reimbursement
items.summary: 50% of the employer's PF contribution for 5 years, capped at ₹5 crore per unit, in Groups D, D+ and below.
details: Counted from commencement of production; eligible employees only.
conditions: Groups D, D+ and special areas only

items.name: MSME performance-linked support
items.summary: Technology upgradation 50% up to ₹25 lakh; quality certification 75% up to ₹1 lakh; patents up to ₹10 lakh.
details: Technology upgradation 50% of added equipment ≤₹25L over 5 yrs; energy audit 50% ≤₹2L, water audit ≤₹1L; energy-efficient equipment 50% ≤₹5L; credit rating 50% ≤₹1L; quality/GMP/hallmark certification 75% ≤₹1L; patent/copyright/trademark/GI ≤₹2L domestic, ≤₹10L international; ZED 50% ≤₹50,000.
conditions: Available to existing MSMEs

items.name: Market access support
items.summary: 30% of trade-fair costs up to ₹5 lakh domestic/₹10 lakh international; SME listing 50% up to ₹5 lakh.
details: Trade fairs: registration, participation and promotional costs per event. SME-exchange listing: 50% of cost up to ₹5 lakh, or the CA-certified actual cost.

items.name: Additional incentive for women and SC/ST enterprises (2025 policy)
items.summary: Extra incentive up to 20% of fixed capital investment for SC/ST-owned and women-owned enterprises.
details: 5%-20% depending on location (one secondary source). Women-owned units must also employ a minimum number of women. Whether it is paid as capital subsidy or a higher IPS cap is unconfirmed.
items.extraFor: SC/ST-owned; women-owned with a minimum number of women employees
conditions: Awaiting the implementing scheme
items.onlyText: Only for SC/ST-owned units, or women-owned units that employ a minimum number of women

items.name: Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar special incentive scheme for SC/ST entrepreneurs (linked to PSI-2019)
items.summary: SC/ST-owned units: capital subsidy of 15%-30% of fixed capital investment, capped at ₹15-30 lakh by zone.
details: A, B, C: 15% ≤₹15L; D: 20% ≤₹20L; D+, Vidarbha, Marathwada, Ratnagiri, Sindhudurg, Dhule: 25% ≤₹25L; No-Industry/Naxal/Aspirational: 30% ≤₹30L. An interest subsidy is also referenced (rate unconfirmed).
items.extraFor: SC/ST only (required ownership % unconfirmed)
conditions: GR dated 2022-01-18; uses PSI-2019 eligibility; valid 2019-04-01 to 2024-03-31 or until a new scheme
Status under the 2025 policy unconfirmed
items.onlyText: Only for SC/ST entrepreneurs

items.name: One-time scaling grant
items.summary: Grant when an MSME moves up a size class: up to ₹5 lakh, ₹10 lakh or ₹25 lakh.
details: Micro to small: 50% of additional investment or ₹5L, whichever is less. Small to medium: up to ₹10L. Medium to large: up to ₹25L. Limited to the first 25,000 eligible MSMEs.
conditions: First 25,000 MSMEs only
items.scope: Paid when the unit moves up a size class, for example from micro to small; first 25,000 MSMEs only

items.name: Chief Minister's Employment Generation Programme (CMEGP)
items.summary: Bank-linked margin-money subsidy of 15%-35% of project cost for new micro units.
details: Project cost limit from 2025-04-01: ₹1 crore (manufacturing), ₹50 lakh (services/agri-business). General category: 15% urban, 25% rural. Reserved categories: 25% urban, 35% rural. Rupee caps on the subsidy unconfirmed.
items.extraFor: Reserved categories (SC/ST, women, OBC, minorities, ex-servicemen, PwD) get 10 percentage points more
conditions: New units only
Age 18+ (upper age limit removed)
8th pass needed for larger projects

items.name: Annasaheb Patil Arthik Magas Vikas Mahamandal interest refund schemes (IR-I individual, IR-II group)
items.summary: Interest refund up to 12% on bank business loans: individuals up to ₹15 lakh loan (max ₹4.5 lakh over 7 years); groups ₹5-50 lakh (max ₹15 lakh over 5 years)
details: Individual scheme: bank business loan up to ₹15 lakh; the Mahamandal refunds interest up to 12%, capped at ₹4.5 lakh over a maximum of 7 years, paid to the Aadhaar-linked account.
Group scheme: registered groups of at least 2 members can borrow ₹5 lakh to ₹50 lakh depending on group size, with interest refund up to ₹15 lakh over 5 years.
conditions: Only for the Maratha community (and other groups notified by the Mahamandal); family income up to ₹8 lakh a year.
Get a Letter of Intent on the Mahamandal portal, take the loan from a participating bank, then claim refund only after EMIs are paid on time.
items.onlyText: Only for Maratha-community entrepreneurs with family income up to ₹8 lakh

items.name: Vasantrao Naik Vimukta Jati and Nomadic Tribes Development Corporation: seed capital and direct loan schemes
items.summary: Seed capital loans up to ₹5 lakh (corporation gives about 25% margin money at 4%) and interest-free direct loans up to ₹10 lakh
details: Seed capital scheme: project up to ₹5 lakh; corporation lends the margin share at 4% for 5 years and a bank lends the rest.
Direct loan scheme: up to ₹10 lakh from the corporation with no interest charged.
The corporation is also the state channelising agency for NBCFDC term loans.
conditions: For Vimukta Jati, Nomadic Tribe (Bhatkya Jamati) and Special Backward Class members in Maharashtra.
Apply to the district office of the corporation; terms may be revised each year.
items.onlyText: Only for VJNT and Special Backward Class entrepreneurs in Maharashtra

items.name: Mahatma Phule and Sant Rohidas (LIDCOM) corporation self-employment schemes (50% subsidy and seed capital)
items.summary: State 50% subsidy scheme and seed capital scheme for SC self-employment projects; plus NSFDC term loans (amounts not confirmed)
details: Mahatma Phule Backward Class Development Corporation runs a state 50% subsidy scheme and Seed Capital Yojana for Scheduled Caste and Navbauddha applicants, plus NSFDC term loans and Mahila Samriddhi Yojana.

Sant Rohidas Leather Industries and Charmakar Development Corporation (LIDCOM) runs a 50% subsidy scheme and seed capital scheme with concessional interest on the margin money for Chambhar, Dhor, Holar and Mochi communities.
conditions: Applicant must belong to the eligible Scheduled Caste groups and live in Maharashtra.
Apply at the district office of the relevant corporation; subsidy caps are set by the corporation.
items.onlyText: Only for Scheduled Caste / Navbauddha applicants (LIDCOM: Charmakar communities)
apply: Bank of Maharashtra list of state programmes

items.name: Aai women-centric tourism policy: interest refund for women tourism businesses
items.summary: Interest refund on bank loans up to ₹15 lakh for women-owned tourism units: up to 12%, ₹4.5 lakh or 7 years, whichever comes first
details: Covers women-owned and run hotels, restaurants, homestays, travel agencies and other tourism businesses.
About 900 loans had been sanctioned by March 2026.
conditions: Business must be owned and managed by a woman; units such as hotels or travel agencies must have at least 50% women staff.
Register with Maharashtra Tourism (DoT) and take a loan from a participating bank.
items.onlyText: Only for women-owned tourism businesses
apply: Maharashtra Directorate of Tourism / participating banks

items.name: Punyashlok Ahilyadevi Holkar Women Startup Scheme (MSInS)
items.summary: One-time grant of ₹1 lakh to ₹25 lakh for women-led DPIIT startups with ₹10 lakh to ₹1 crore revenue
details: Run by the Maharashtra State Innovation Society (MSInS) for early-stage women-led startups.
conditions: DPIIT-recognised startup registered in Maharashtra with women holding more than 51%.
Operating for over one year; revenue between ₹10 lakh and ₹1 crore; no other Maharashtra government grant taken.
Apply online at msins.in when a call is open.
items.onlyText: Only for women-led (51%+) DPIIT-recognised startups

items.name: Maharashtra Startup, Entrepreneurship and Innovation Policy 2025 (CM Maha-Fund and startup reimbursements)
items.summary: ₹500 crore CM Maha-Fund for 25,000 early entrepreneurs; pilot work orders up to ₹25 lakh; patent, quality certification and exhibition reimbursements
details: Approved by the state cabinet on 5 Aug 2025; all schemes run through MSInS.
Pilot work orders up to ₹25 lakh with government departments for Maharashtra Startup Week winners.
Reimbursement of patent filing, product quality certification and domestic/international exhibition costs.
Loan facility through financial institutions for startups with confirmed work orders.
conditions: Startups recognised under the state/DPIIT framework and based in Maharashtra.
Maha-Fund beneficiaries are chosen through a multi-stage selection; detailed scheme guidelines are issued by MSInS.

items.name: Maharashtra Integrated and Sustainable Textile Policy 2023-28
items.summary: Capital subsidy for textile units by segment and zone; 50% subsidy for green projects (ETP up to Rs 5 cr, ZLD up to Rs 10 cr)
details: Covers ginning and pressing, spinning, powerloom, handloom, processing, knitting, hosiery and garmenting, sericulture, wool and synthetic yarn units; capital subsidy and power concession rates vary by segment and zone (GR tables and Annexures A and B).
Green projects: 50% capital subsidy for effluent treatment plants (up to Rs 5 crore), zero liquid discharge (up to Rs 10 crore) and common steam generation (up to Rs 1 crore).
Government Resolution No. Policy 2023/C.R.81/Tex-5 dated 2 Jun 2023; valid to 31 Mar 2028.
items.extraFor: Additional incentives for women-led units (amount not confirmed).
conditions: Textile value-chain units in Maharashtra; segment-wise rates are in the GR.
Apply to the Textile Commissionerate, Government of Maharashtra.

items.name: Maharashtra Tourism Policy 2024: capital investment incentive for tourism units
items.summary: Capital incentive of 20% (Zone A) to 30% (Zone C and special tourism zones) of eligible investment for MSME tourism units, paid over 3 years
details: Rates for MSME-range tourism projects: Zone A (MMR) 20%, Zone B (Nashik, Pune, Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar, Nagpur corporations) 25%, Zone C (rest of state) 30%, special tourism zones/districts 30%.

Eligible units include hotels, resorts, homestays, tented stays, agro, rural and eco-tourism units, food and beverage units, travel facilities, MICE centres, adventure and recreation units, houseboats and AR/VR experience zones.
Paid in three equal annual instalments from commercial operation; overall cap on all benefits 40%.
Government Resolution of 18 Jul 2024; valid for 10 years.
items.extraFor: Extra 5% capital incentive for new units at least 51% owned and managed by women or SC/ST entrepreneurs.
conditions: Register with the Directorate of Tourism and apply for an eligibility certificate within 180 days of starting operations.
Tourism MSME bands: micro up to Rs 2.5 crore investment, small up to Rs 25 crore, medium up to Rs 125 crore, with minimum direct jobs set in the policy.

items.name: Maharashtra Tourism Policy 2024: SGST, electricity duty and stamp duty relief for tourism MSMEs
items.summary: SGST reimbursement 50% to 90% for 5 to 10 years, electricity duty and stamp duty exemption 50% to 100%, by zone
details: Zone A: 50% SGST reimbursement, 50% electricity duty and 50% stamp duty exemption for 5 years.
Zone B: 75% each for 7 years.
Zone C and special tourism zones: 90% SGST reimbursement, 100% electricity duty and stamp duty exemption for 10 years.
100% stamp duty reimbursement on mortgage loans in all zones; quality certification reimbursed at 50%, up to Rs 2 lakh (national) or Rs 10 lakh (international).
conditions: Eligible tourism unit with an eligibility certificate from the Directorate of Tourism.
Apply through the Directorate of Tourism.

items.name: Madh Kendra Yojana (Honey Centre Scheme, Maharashtra State Khadi and Village Industries Board)
items.summary: 50% grant on beekeeping boxes, colonies and equipment; balance as beneficiary share; free 10 to 20 day training
details: Covers individual beekeepers, progressive beekeepers (centre operators) and registered institutions.
Includes training, bee boxes, colonies and honey-processing equipment; MSKVIB buys back honey through its Madh Sanchalanalaya, Mahabaleshwar.
Run under GR No. KVIB-2017/Pra.Kra.-16/Udyog-6 dated 18 June 2019.
conditions: Individual: literate, 18+, 10-day training; centre operator: 10th pass, 21+, at least 1 acre owned or leased; institution: registered, 1 acre for 10 years and 500 sq ft training building.
Apply online on the MSKVIB website or at the District Village Industries Office.
items.onlyText: Only for beekeepers, beekeeping centre operators and registered institutions in Maharashtra

items.name: Mukhyamantri Krishi va Anna Prakriya Yojana (Chief Minister Agriculture and Food Processing Scheme)
items.summary: 30% credit-linked back-ended subsidy on civil works and machinery, up to ₹50 lakh, for agri and food processing units
details: Subsidy of 30% of eligible project cost (technical civil works, plant and machinery), capped at ₹50 lakh.
Covers new units and upgradation, expansion or modernisation of agro and food processing units.
Paid in two equal instalments through the lending bank after partial and full completion.
conditions: Bank term loan is required; apply offline to the District Superintending Agriculture Officer with DPR and bank sanction.
District committee recommends and a Commissionerate committee gives in-principle approval; existing units applying for expansion need 3 years' audited accounts.
Scheme reported as extended to 2026-27.

states.short: Industrial and Investment Promotion Policy of Manipur 2022
states.statusText: In force, but the official copy is a scanned gazette and its incentive amounts are not confirmed. Ask the Directorate of Trade, Commerce and Industries or your DIC.

portal.label: Manipur single window: State Incentive Scheme service

items.name: Industrial estate land and shed allotment (Manipur Industrial Estates Policy, 2026)
items.summary: Up to 3% upfront rebate on freehold conversion charges for startups and women; allotment priority for women and SC/ST.
details: Leasehold-to-freehold conversion charge: 25% (micro), 35% (small), 45% (medium) of market value; startups and women entrepreneurs get an upfront rebate of up to 3%
At least 50% of factory sheds reserved for local entrepreneurs starting new units
items.extraFor: Women: conversion-charge rebate and allotment priority; SC/ST: allotment priority
conditions: Only for plots or sheds in state industrial estates
Notification TnC-2/3/2026-TCI-T,C&I dated 26 May 2026; in force from gazette publication on 3 Jun 2026
Rent as prescribed by Government, paid online

items.name: Manipur Start Up Scheme 2.0
items.summary: Idea-stage grant up to ₹3 lakh; revenue-stage support up to ₹100 lakh including a 30% grant
details: Idea stage: grant of up to ₹3 lakh with mandatory business incubation training.
Revenue stage: financial assistance up to ₹100 lakh including a 30% grant; a Stand Up track on the same terms for SC/ST/OBC, women and minority entrepreneurs.
Run by the Planning Department (Startup Manipur); related Manipur Startup Venture Fund with NEDFi.
items.extraFor: Stand Up track for SC, ST, OBC, women and minority entrepreneurs
conditions: Manipur-based entrepreneurs selected by the Technical Appraisal Committee.
Apply on the Startup Manipur portal when a call is open.

items.name: CMESS (support for existing micro-entrepreneurs, Start Up Scheme 2.0)
items.summary: 30% subsidy on project cost for existing micro-entrepreneurs in Manipur
details: Financial assistance with a 30% subsidy of project cost for existing micro enterprises, under Start Up Scheme 2.0.
Technical Appraisal Committee meetings to shortlist CMESS candidates were held on 14 to 19 Sep 2026.
conditions: Existing micro-entrepreneur in Manipur.
Apply on the Startup Manipur portal; selection by the Technical Appraisal Committee.

items.name: Manipur Credit Guarantee Scheme (MCGS) with CGTMSE
items.summary: State fund tops up CGTMSE cover so collateral-free MSE loans up to Rs 2 crore get 100% guarantee
details: CGTMSE covers 50% to 85% and the state's Rs 10 crore fund covers the rest, taking guarantee cover to 100%.
Applies to manufacturing, services, trading and educational institutions; retail trade included.
Extended in July 2025 to first-generation entrepreneurs, including displaced persons in relief camps (initial loans of Rs 50,000).
conditions: Micro or small enterprise in Manipur; loan from a CGTMSE member lending institution.
Apply for the loan at a participating bank branch (SBI, PNB, Canara, Union, BoB, HDFC, Axis and others).

items.name: Manipur Startup 2.0 Policy 2022
items.summary: Seed grant up to Rs 3 lakh, scale-up support up to Rs 1 crore, patent cost up to Rs 2 lakh/Rs 5 lakh
details: Ideation-stage seed grant up to Rs 3 lakh; scaling assistance up to Rs 100 lakh.
100% patent cost reimbursement up to Rs 2 lakh (domestic) and Rs 5 lakh (international).
100% reimbursement of stamp duty, registration and conversion fees on the first sale or lease deed.
Rs 30 crore Manipur Startup Venture Fund managed by NEDFi.
Relaxed prior turnover and experience, and EMD exemption, in state tenders.
items.extraFor: Dedicated incentives for women-led startups (target of 40% women-led startups).
conditions: DPIIT-recognised or Manipur-recognised startup.
Apply through Startup Manipur.

states.short: Meghalaya Industrial and Investment Promotion Policy 2024
states.period: In force to 20 Dec 2034; registration window extended by one year in Aug 2026
states.statusText: In force. In Aug 2026 the state Cabinet extended the unit registration window by one year; confirm the new closing date with MIPA before applying.

portal.label: Meghalaya Investment Promotion Authority

states.zones: Rates are statewide; priority sectors get more.
states.notes: Micro units need at least ₹50 lakh of investment. Trading is not covered.

items.name: State Capital Investment Subsidy
items.summary: 30% of plant & machinery or service building/assets; max ₹10 crore (priority) or ₹8 crore (non-priority).
details: MSMEs: 30% of plant & machinery (manufacturing) or building and durable assets (services); cap ₹10 crore Priority, ₹8 crore Non-priority
Minimum investment: ₹50 lakh for micro units; ₹1 crore in plant & machinery for other manufacturing; ₹50 lakh for services
items.extraFor: Units majority-owned by persons with disabilities get an extra 10% (micro) or 5% (small); see special category
conditions: New units registered within the window, or expansion of at least 25% of existing investment
Negative list excluded
Commercial production within 4 years of registration

items.name: State Interest Subvention
items.summary: 5% (priority) or 4% (non-priority) interest subvention for up to 7 years.
details: On loans up to ₹250 crore principal for plant & machinery or building/durable assets; max 7 consecutive years; paid only after commercial production starts
conditions: New and expanding units

items.name: Net SGST reimbursement
items.summary: 100% of net SGST: 15 years capped at 150% of investment (priority) or 10 years at 100%.
details: Net SGST = SGST paid minus input tax credit
Priority: up to 15 years, ceiling 150% of eligible investment
Non-priority: up to 10 years, ceiling 100%
Yearly payout limited to one-tenth of the total eligible amount
conditions: New units with a Meghalaya GSTIN only; not for expansion

items.name: EPF reimbursement
items.summary: 100% of employer EPF contribution for local employees for 3 years (4 years for women).
details: For employees domiciled in Meghalaya; cap 12% of basic plus DA, or ₹1,800 a month, whichever is lower; counted from commercial production
items.extraFor: Women employees: one extra year
conditions: Local hiring: at least 25% of managerial and 90% of non-managerial staff in years 1-2, then 50% and 90%

items.name: Transport subsidy
items.summary: Inland transport subsidy up to ₹15 lakh a year for 4 years (priority) or ₹10 lakh for 3 years.
details: Actual cost of transporting raw materials sourced within Meghalaya and finished goods made in Meghalaya
conditions: Micro and small units only

items.name: Power connection and captive generation support
items.summary: Micro/small: power-line cost reimbursed up to ₹10 lakh; 50% generating-set subsidy up to ₹10-25 lakh.
details: Micro and small: 100% of 11 kV+ line and transformer cost up to ₹10 lakh; 50% of service connection charges up to ₹2 lakh
Generating sets: 50%, up to ₹10 lakh (conventional) or ₹25 lakh (renewable) for micro/small; ₹50 lakh or ₹1 crore for medium
conditions: Generating sets for captive use

items.name: Special category additional capital incentive
items.summary: Extra 10% (micro) or 5% (small, max ₹50 lakh) capital incentive for units majority-owned by persons with disabilities.
details: Micro: extra 10% on the cost of factory building and plant
Small: extra 5% on plant & machinery, ceiling ₹50 lakh
items.extraFor: Majority shareholder must be a person with disability and domiciled in Meghalaya; other 'special category individuals' are to be notified by Government; no women- or SC/ST-specific top-up found
conditions: Same eligibility as the capital subsidy
items.onlyText: Only for units majority-owned by a person with disability domiciled in Meghalaya

items.name: Water conservation incentives
items.summary: 50% of rainwater-harvesting cost (up to ₹2 lakh for micro/small) and 75% of water-audit cost up to ₹1 lakh.
details: Rainwater harvesting: 50%, up to ₹2 lakh (micro/small) or ₹10 lakh (medium/large)
Water audit: 75%, up to ₹1 lakh, if water use falls at least 25%
conditions: As per MIIPP 2024 section 3.4.6

items.name: CM-ELEVATE (Chief Minister's credit-linked subsidy programme)
items.summary: Credit-linked subsidy of 35% to 75% of project cost for entrepreneurs in 15 sectors
details: Subsidy of 35% to 75% of project cost depending on the sub-scheme, linked to a bank loan, with handholding and bank linkage through PRIME Meghalaya.

Sectors include tourism homestays and vehicles, agri warehouses, polyhouses, piggery, poultry, goat and dairy, cinema, sports and wellness, common facility centres, sericulture and weaving, and 'any business venture'.
Targets 20,000 entrepreneurs over five years.
conditions: Individuals and registered or unregistered entities in Meghalaya; beneficiaries are selected.
Apply through the MeghalayaOne e-services portal.

items.name: PRIME (Promotion and Incubation of Market-driven Enterprises) - Kick Start Grant and Scale Up Loan
items.summary: Kick Start Grant of up to Rs 5 lakh for entrepreneurs, plus scale-up loans, incubation and mentoring at PRIME hubs
details: Meghalaya's flagship entrepreneurship programme with PRIME hubs in Shillong, Nongpoh and Tura; runs in 11 districts.
Also links entrepreneurs to bank credit and to the Chief Minister's E-Champion Challenge.
conditions: Entrepreneurs and startups based in Meghalaya.
Register and apply on the MyMeg portal.

items.name: Meghalaya Startup Policy 2018 incentives (via PRIME)
items.summary: GST reimbursement up to Rs 7 lakh a year for 5 years, 50% lease rental (max Rs 2 lakh a year) and 50% power subsidy for startups
details: 100% reimbursement of stamp duty, registration or conversion fee on the first sale or lease deed.
50% subsidy on digital infrastructure up to Rs 2 lakh.
Patent support: 75% reimbursement on filing, plus 25% on grant of international patents.
conditions: Startup recognised under the Meghalaya Startup Policy.
Apply through PRIME / Commerce and Industries Department.
items.onlyText: Only for startups recognised under the Meghalaya Startup Policy

items.name: Meghalaya Procurement Preference Policy for Micro and Small Enterprises 2020
items.summary: Registered Meghalaya MSEs win up to 25% of a tender at up to 20% above L1; EMD exempt, free tender papers, no turnover test
details: Notified 11 Feb 2021 (No. IND.37/2019/86, Gazette 6 Aug 2021); valid for ten years.
Price preference: registered MSEs can be awarded up to 25% of tender value at up to 20% above a non-registered L1, and get first right on the other 75% if they match L1.
Departments and aided bodies must buy at least 25% of annual needs from registered MSEs; 62 illustrative items listed.
Exempt from earnest money; tender documents free; no minimum turnover requirement.
conditions: Udyam-registered manufacturing or service unit in Meghalaya with head or registered office in the state, employing at least 60% local tribals; traders excluded.
Register with the Directorate of Commerce and Industries (fee Rs 500, valid 3 years, renewable).
apply: Directorate of Commerce and Industries, Meghalaya

items.name: Meghalaya Chief Minister's Homestay Scheme: Boutique Homestay component
items.summary: Up to Rs 15 lakh EMI support (plus Rs 5 lakh National Games bonus) for new 10+ room boutique homestays, stackable with UNNATI and MIIPP 2024
details: Tourism Department pays Rs 10 lakh as EMI support (12 months after operations start), plus a Rs 5 lakh bonus for units in Shillong, Tura or Jowai completed by 1 Feb 2027.
Units can also claim UNNATI 30% capital subsidy and interest subvention, and MIIPP 2024 interest subvention, GST reimbursement and EPF support.
Bank loan of about 90% (Meghalaya Rural Bank or notified bank) with 10% own contribution; minimum project cost about Rs 80 lakh.
conditions: Meghalaya domicile aged 18 to 58, or a registered entity in Meghalaya; one member per family; not a loan defaulter.
Unit of at least 10 rooms with at least Rs 75 lakh in building and durable assets; own land or lease of 15+ years.
Register on the Invest Meghalaya and UNNATI portals; District Tourist Officer inspection, then state screening committee approval; must run as tourism accommodation for 15 years.

states.statusText: A new policy was notified around Oct 2025, but its incentive terms are not yet confirmed. Ask the Commerce and Industries Department.

portal.label: Commerce and Industries Department

items.name: Net SGST reimbursement (Industrial and Investment Policy of Mizoram 2025)
items.summary: Reimbursement of net SGST paid for 5 years from start of commercial production
details: Net SGST paid in cash (excluding input tax credit) is reimbursed for 5 years; no fixed cap.
Policy notified on 21 Aug 2025.
conditions: New manufacturing MSMEs in Mizoram.
Claim within 6 months of the SGST return filing date.

items.name: Interest subsidy on term loans (Mizoram Policy 2025)
items.summary: Up to 5% a year interest subsidy on term loans for 5 years, max ₹10 lakh a year
details: Interest subsidy of up to 5% a year on term loans for 5 years, capped at ₹10 lakh a year.
conditions: New MSME units in Mizoram.
Apply to the Department of Industries after loan disbursal.

items.name: Power and water cost subsidy (Mizoram Policy 2025)
items.summary: 60% (micro), 25% (small), 15% (medium) of power and water costs for 5 years
details: Power: 60% for micro, 25% for small, 15% for medium units, capped at ₹20 lakh a year.
Water: same rates, capped at ₹10 lakh a year.
For 5 years from start of production.
conditions: New MSMEs in Mizoram.

items.name: Infrastructure capital subsidies (Mizoram Policy 2025)
items.summary: 25% on land development (₹10 lakh) and factory building (₹15 lakh); 50% on power lines (₹5 lakh), generator (₹7 lakh), ETP (₹10 lakh)
details: Land development 25% up to ₹10 lakh and factory building 25% up to ₹15 lakh, for units in notified industrial areas within 5 years.
Power line and transformer 50% up to ₹5 lakh; captive generator 50% up to ₹7 lakh; effluent treatment 50% up to ₹10 lakh; pollution-control devices 25%.
50% of the cost of transporting plant and machinery, within 1 year of production.
conditions: New MSMEs in Mizoram.
Apply to the Department of Industries with cost proofs.

items.name: Trade fair support and Made in Mizoram promotion (Mizoram Policy 2025)
items.summary: 30% of stall rent at national and international fairs, up to ₹1 lakh per fair, 2 fairs a year
details: 30% reimbursement of stall rental, up to ₹1 lakh per fair, maximum 2 fairs per MSME a year.
25% of state procurement reserved for Mizoram MSEs with at least 70% local workforce, with up to 12% price preference and tender fee/EMD exemption.
conditions: Mizoram MSMEs; prior government approval needed for each fair.

items.name: Bana Kaih (Mizoram Handholding Scheme) - interest-free bank loans
items.summary: Collateral-free bank loan up to Rs 50 lakh with up to 100% interest subvention and state guarantee for selected Progress Partners
details: Loans through SBI, Mizoram Rural Bank and Mizoram Co-operative Apex Bank; full interest subvention for regular repayers.
Phase 3 (Bana Kaih 3.0) launched September 2026 with Rs 350 crore for 2026-27.
Grant support under the Chief Minister's Special Category Scheme for those who cannot take loans.
conditions: Selected Progress Partners with a livelihood or business project in Mizoram (agriculture and small industry).
Apply through the implementing departments; banks appraise and sanction.

items.name: Mizoram Procurement Preference Policy for MSEs 2025
items.summary: Mizoram MSEs get up to 12% price preference, 25% reserved share of state purchases, and tender fee and EMD exemption
details: Launched 7 Oct 2025 under the Industrial and Investment Policy of Mizoram 2025 (notified 21 Aug 2025).
Registered Mizoram-based manufacturers and service providers get a price preference of up to 12% over the lowest out-of-state bid.
Every government department must buy at least 25% of its annual goods and services from registered Mizoram MSEs.
Registered MSEs are exempt from tender fees and EMD, and get preference in tied bids.
conditions: Unit must be based in Mizoram, employ at least 70% local workforce, and register under the policy with the Commerce and Industries Department.
Benefit applies when bidding in Mizoram government tenders.

items.name: Mizoram Entrepreneurship and Startup Policy 2019 (MSUM grants)
items.summary: Seed grant up to Rs 2 lakh, accelerator funding up to Rs 25 lakh; Mizoram Rahbi seed up to Rs 7.5 lakh
details: MSUM seed grant up to Rs 2 lakh for early-stage ventures.
MSUM accelerator funding up to Rs 25 lakh for scaling.
Mizoram Rahbi seed grants up to Rs 7.5 lakh with mentoring and milestone tracking.
conditions: Startup based in Mizoram.
Apply through the Mizoram Startup Mission calls.

states.short: Nagaland Trade, Investment and Industrial Policy 2025
states.statusText: Notified, but not yet running: as of Sep 2026 no unit had been registered and the online portal was still being set up.

portal.label: Department of Industries and Commerce; apply through the DIC

states.zones: No location zones; amounts depend on size, thrust-sector status and women or PwD ownership.
states.notes: Units need at least 5 employees, half of them indigenous inhabitants of Nagaland.

items.name: State Capital Investment Incentive (SCII)
items.summary: 30% of plant & machinery or service building/assets, up to ₹10 crore, for small and medium units.
details: 30% of plant & machinery (manufacturing) or building and durable assets (services), max ₹10 crore
If the unit claims the UNNATI 2024 capital incentive, SCII pays only the difference
Micro units get state soft loans instead
conditions: New units (registered on or after 8 May 2025) or substantial expansion (at least 25% more investment)
Total from all state incentives capped at ₹10 crore per unit

items.name: State soft loans at 6%
items.summary: 6% state soft loans: micro up to ₹10-20 lakh, small up to ₹50 lakh-₹1 crore, retail/service ₹10 lakh.
details: Technology upgradation or expansion of existing units: up to ₹10 lakh (tiny/micro), ₹50 lakh (small)
New units in thrust sectors: up to ₹20 lakh (tiny/micro), ₹1 crore (small)
Retail and service establishments: up to ₹10 lakh
items.extraFor: 25% of soft-loan funds reserved for women, 5% for persons with disabilities, 5% for green-technology units
conditions: Units taking soft loans cannot also claim the 5% interest subvention
Repayment terms unconfirmed

items.name: State Capital Interest Subvention Incentive (SCISI)
items.summary: 5% interest subvention for 5 years on loans up to ₹1 crore, for thrust-sector units.
details: On loans up to ₹1 crore for plant & machinery or building/durable assets; 5 years from commercial production
conditions: Thrust sectors only
Not available with state soft loans

items.name: SGST reimbursement
items.summary: 100% of net SGST for 5 years for new units investing at least ₹50 lakh.
details: 100% of net SGST paid, for 5 years from commercial production or operation; no percentage-of-investment cap stated
conditions: New units only
Minimum investment ₹50 lakh

items.name: Stamp duty and registration fee on loan documents
items.summary: 50% exemption of stamp duty and registration fee on loan and mortgage documents for 5 years.
details: Applies to instruments for securing loans from financial institutions, including mortgage of fixed assets
conditions: Not a land-purchase exemption
Whether existing units qualify is unclear

items.name: Power tariff subsidy and power-line drawal
items.summary: 25% of power bills for 5 years (max ₹5 lakh a year) for units of 100 kVA or more.
details: Installed load of 100 kVA/134 HP or more: 25% of actual tariff for 5 years, max ₹5 lakh a year
One-time reimbursement of 33/11 kV line-drawal cost up to ₹10 lakh
conditions: Tariff subsidy only for units of 100 kVA/134 HP and above

items.name: Quality certification, ZED and IP support
items.summary: 50% of certification cost up to ₹1 lakh; 100% of ZED certification and patent/GI filing costs.
details: ISO, FSSAI, GI, organic and similar certifications: 50%, max ₹1 lakh
ZED certification: 100% for all stages
Patent, IP and GI-tag filing: 100% for new enterprises
conditions: Registered eligible units

items.name: Market development and transport incentive
items.summary: Trade fairs: 50% of fees up to ₹50,000 per event; outbound freight: 50% up to ₹50 lakh a year.
details: Domestic trade fairs outside Nagaland: 50% of rent/fee, max ₹50,000 per event, 2 events a year
Transport of goods outside the state: 50% of cost, max ₹50 lakh a year for 5 years
conditions: Registered eligible units

items.name: Women and PwD entrepreneur incentives
items.summary: Extra 10% capital subsidy on plant & machinery, up to ₹10 lakh, for women- or PwD-owned units.
details: Women: 10% of plant & machinery, max ₹10 lakh; priority in industrial estates
PwD (40%+ disability): 10% of plant & machinery, max ₹10 lakh; 50% rent subsidy in Government industrial parks
items.extraFor: Women-owned (at least 60% held by a woman or women) and PwD-owned units; no SC/ST-specific provision
conditions: Same general eligibility as other NTIIP incentives
items.onlyText: Only for units at least 60% owned by women, or owned by persons with disabilities

items.name: Chief Minister's Micro Finance Initiative (CMMFI)
items.summary: 30% back-ended subsidy on bank-financed projects up to ₹15 lakh (60% bank loan, 10% own share)
details: Project funding: 10% beneficiary share, 60% bank loan, 30% back-ended state subsidy; project ceiling ₹15 lakh.
Moratorium up to 6 months and repayment up to 7 years.
Covers allied farming, cold storage, transport vehicles, post-harvest processing and micro-enterprises such as hostels, vocational training, logistics, mobile food, gyms and homestays.
conditions: Entrepreneurs, unemployed youth, SHGs, FPOs and cooperatives in Nagaland.
Apply to the District Level Implementation-cum-Monitoring Committee under the Deputy Commissioner; screening with bank representatives.

items.name: Startup Nagaland incentives (Nagaland Startup Policy)
items.summary: Seed grant up to Rs 1 lakh, SGST reimbursement up to Rs 1.5 lakh a year for 3 years, and 50% marketing and digital support up to Rs 2 lakh each
details: Power subsidy of 50% of the electricity bill up to Rs 1 lakh a year for two years.
Patent filing costs reimbursed up to Rs 1 lakh (Rs 1.5 lakh for women-led startups), half on filing and half on grant.
25% of state startup funds reserved for women-led startups.
items.extraFor: Women-led startups: extra 30% SGST reimbursement for up to two more years, higher patent cap and 25% fund reservation
conditions: Startup registered with Startup Nagaland.
Apply through the Department of Industries and Commerce, Nagaland.
items.onlyText: Only for startups registered with Startup Nagaland

items.name: Nagaland Tourism Policy 2024: training subsidy and marketing support
items.summary: Course-fee reimbursement for staff trained at recognised institutes, plus support for one tourism event a year for registered units
details: Units that send staff to recognised training and keep them for 6 months can get the course fee reimbursed, based on a third-party skill evaluation.
Registered tourism entrepreneurs can get marketing and promotion help, and financial assistance for one tourism event per year.
Tourism has priority-sector status under the state industrial policy; amounts not confirmed.
conditions: Unit must be registered with the Nagaland Tourism Department and meet recognition norms.
Apply to the Department of Tourism, Nagaland.

states.statusText: In force.

portal.label: e-MSME Seva (AIM 2.0), MSME Department

states.zones: Rates are statewide. The 11 industrially backward districts (Kalahandi, Nuapada, Bolangir, Subarnapur, Koraput, Malkangiri, Rayagada, Nabarangpur, Kandhamal, Gajapati, Mayurbhanj), some IDCO estates and focus sectors get 5% more capital subsidy.
states.notes: Trading is excluded; services qualify only if listed in Annexure II. Units whose first investment was before 30 Nov 2022 stay under the 2016 policy. The same benefit cannot be claimed under another state or central scheme.

items.name: Capital Investment Subsidy (CIS)
items.summary: 25% of plant and machinery cost, max ₹2 crore; 30% (max ₹2.5 crore) for special categories.
details: General 25% of P&M, max ₹2 crore; SC/ST/women/PwD/technical graduates 30%, max ₹2.5 crore. Top-ups: +5% (max ₹20 lakh) in backward districts, IDCO estates, Biju Expressway corridor or focus sectors; +5% (max ₹25 lakh) for green measures. Anchor units 30% (max ₹4 crore); EV components 30% (max ₹3 crore).
items.extraFor: SC, ST, women, PwD and technical degree/diploma holders (51%+ shareholding): 30%, cap ₹2.5 crore
conditions: P&M investment up to ₹10 crore (EV components up to ₹50 crore)
Production within 3 years of first fixed-capital investment
Services only if listed in Annexure II
Not on negative list

items.name: Interest subsidy on term loan
items.summary: 50% of term-loan interest for five years from production start, max ₹1 crore in total.
details: Reimbursement of 50% of interest paid on term loans for 5 years from commencement of production; overall ceiling ₹1 crore; P&M up to ₹50 crore; new enterprises only.
conditions: New enterprise
P&M up to ₹50 crore

items.name: SGST reimbursement
items.summary: 75% of net SGST paid in cash for three years; pioneer units 100% for five years.
details: General: 75% of net SGST paid in cash for 3 years, capped at 100% of P&M cost. Pioneer enterprises (first five units making a product new to Odisha): 100% for 5 years, capped at 200% of P&M cost.
conditions: P&M up to ₹50 crore
New units or expansion/modernisation/diversification

items.name: Stamp duty exemption
items.summary: Stamp duty exemption: 100% if P&M up to ₹10 crore, 75% if ₹10-50 crore.
details: On land/shed transferred by Government, IDCO or private estate developers to new units, or fresh land for expansion/modernisation/diversification; also units bought under the SFC Act, SARFAESI or NCLT/IBC.
conditions: P&M up to ₹50 crore

items.name: Land conversion charge exemption
items.summary: Land conversion charges waived: 100% up to 5 acres (P&M up to ₹10 crore); 75% up to 25 acres.
details: 100% exemption up to 5 acres where P&M is up to ₹10 crore; 75% up to 25 acres where P&M is ₹10-50 crore.
conditions: P&M up to ₹50 crore

items.name: Electricity duty exemption
items.summary: Full electricity duty exemption up to 750 kVA contract demand for five years.
details: Exemption from electricity duty for contract demand up to 750 kVA for 5 years from commencement of production; P&M up to ₹50 crore; new enterprises only.
conditions: New enterprise
P&M up to ₹50 crore

items.name: Employment cost subsidy (ESI/EPF reimbursement)
items.summary: Reimburses employer ESI and EPF contributions: 75% for male and 100% for female workers.
details: P&M up to ₹10 crore: 5 years; P&M ₹10-50 crore: 3 years; applies to new units and expansion/modernisation/diversification.
items.extraFor: Female workers: 100% reimbursement (75% for male)
conditions: P&M up to ₹50 crore

items.name: Quality, ZED, technology, patent and trademark support
items.summary: Quality certification 100% up to ₹5 lakh; technology purchase 50% up to ₹20 lakh; patent 100% up to ₹5 lakh.
details: Quality certification 100%, max ₹5 lakh. ZED: 80% of cost left after GoI support; equipment 50% up to ₹2/3/5 lakh (Bronze/Silver/Gold). Technology purchase: 50%, max ₹20 lakh. Patent 100%, max ₹5 lakh; trademark 100%, max ₹3 lakh. Energy audit 75% (max ₹5 lakh); water audit 75% (max ₹1 lakh).
conditions: P&M up to ₹50 crore

items.name: Startup Odisha incentives (Odisha Startup Policy)
items.summary: Monthly allowance of ₹20,000 (₹22,000 for women, SC/ST, SEBC, PwD) for 1 year; product and marketing grant up to ₹15 lakh
details: Monthly allowance of ₹20,000 for one year for recognised startups; ₹22,000 if founders are women, transgender, SC, ST, SEBC or PwD (women-led with 50%+ equity).

Product development and marketing/publicity assistance up to ₹15 lakh (₹16 lakh for the same special categories); patent and IPR filing support; 50% incubator rent subsidy for women-led startups (up to ₹5,000 a month).
items.extraFor: Women, transgender, SC, ST, SEBC and PwD founders: ₹22,000 allowance and ₹16 lakh product grant cap
conditions: Startup recognised by Startup Odisha (MSME Department).
Allowance needs one of: equity of ₹5 lakh to ₹1 crore, a published patent, a government grant, or revenue of ₹50,000 to ₹10 lakh a month.
Apply on the Startup Odisha portal.
items.onlyText: Only for startups recognised by Startup Odisha

items.name: Mukhyamantri Krushi Udyog Yojana (MKUY)
items.summary: 40% capital investment subsidy (50% for SC/ST, women, PwD, agri graduates) up to ₹1 crore for agri, allied and food-processing enterprises
details: Capital investment subsidy of 40% of fixed capital (excluding land), up to ₹1 crore per entrepreneur or family over 10 years; 50% for SC, ST, women, transgender, PwD and agriculture graduates.
Covers agriculture, horticulture, animal resources, fisheries, sericulture and food processing; projects under ₹50 crore; bank loan optional (if used, at least 10% of cost).
Odisha cabinet on 14 Jul 2026 approved ₹2,496 crore for the scheme for 2026-27 to 2030-31.
items.extraFor: 50% subsidy for SC, ST, women, transgender, PwD and agriculture/allied graduates
conditions: Individuals, partnerships, companies, FPOs, SHGs, cooperatives and societies can apply; new projects and expansion allowed.
Do not start construction before District Level Committee approval and the go-ahead letter.
Apply online on the SUGAM portal (APICOL, MKUY).

items.name: Mission Shakti Loan (interest-free loans for women SHGs)
items.summary: Interest-free bank loans up to ₹10 lakh per women SHG when repaid on time; state pays the interest
details: State interest subvention makes the effective interest rate 0% for women SHGs in rural and urban Odisha that repay on time.
Loan ceiling raised to ₹10 lakh; continuation for 2025-26 and later years approved on 15 Apr 2025.
Loans through scheduled commercial banks, RRBs and co-operative banks.
conditions: Women self-help groups in Odisha, any promoting agency
Loan must be repaid on time to get full subvention
Apply through the bank branch and Mission Shakti block office
items.onlyText: Only for women self-help groups in Odisha
apply: Mission Shakti Bank Linkage & Interest Subvention portal

items.name: Odisha Food Processing Policy 2022 – Capital Investment Subsidy
items.summary: 30% capital subsidy on plant and machinery up to ₹3.5 crore (35% up to ₹4 crore for SC/ST, women, PwD, technical entrepreneurs)
details: For food processing units with plant and machinery up to ₹50 crore; new units and expansion, modernisation or diversification.
Extra 5% (up to ₹50 lakh) in industrially backward districts, IDCO estates, aqua parks or the Biju Expressway corridor.
Extra 25% of captive solar plant cost (up to ₹25 lakh); 35% back-ended subsidy on reefer vehicles or mobile pre-cooling vans (up to ₹25 lakh).
Policy in force from 30 Nov 2022; production must start within 3 years of first investment.
items.extraFor: SC, ST, women, persons with disabilities and technical (food-tech/agri qualified) entrepreneurs holding 51%+ get 35% up to ₹4 crore
conditions: Food processing unit in Odisha; some rice mills, oil mills and bakeries are ineligible (Annexure II)
Apply to the DIC/RIC; district committee approves up to ₹1 crore P&M, state committees above
Claims must be filed within the deadline in the operational guidelines
items.onlyText: Only for food processing units

items.name: Odisha Apparel and Technical Textiles Policy 2022 – capital investment subsidy
items.summary: 40% of plant and machinery investment (up to ₹50 crore), paid over 5 years
details: Paid yearly for 5 years at 8% of eligible plant and machinery investment made to date; land and buildings excluded.
Covers investment made in the first 6 years; production must start within 3 years of the first investment.
Market development: 50% of exhibition costs, up to ₹3 lakh (domestic) and ₹6 lakh (overseas), twice per category.
Power tariff, SGST, stamp duty and environment incentives as per Odisha IPR 2022.
conditions: Sector: apparel, garments and technical textiles (NIC 13, 14)
New units or additional units of existing companies only, starting production after the policy notification
At least 200 workers, 90% of them Odisha domicile
Apply through Invest Odisha / GO SWIFT

items.name: Odisha Apparel and Technical Textiles Policy 2022 – employment cost subsidy
items.summary: ₹6,000 per woman worker and ₹5,000 per male worker per month for 5 years
details: Paid for 60 months from start of commercial production.
Wage payments to workers must be Aadhaar-linked.
items.extraFor: Higher rate (₹6,000 a month) for women workers
conditions: Sector: apparel, garments and technical textiles (NIC 13, 14)
New units with at least 200 workers, 90% Odisha domicile
Apply through Invest Odisha / GO SWIFT

items.name: Odisha Export Policy 2022 – export development assistance
items.summary: Free stall at trade fairs, 50% airfare (up to ₹50,000), RCMC fee refund up to ₹40,000, 50% certification costs
details: State bears stall rent at selected domestic and international fairs; 50% of economy airfare for one person per firm.
One-time reimbursement of RCMC fees up to ₹40,000 for first-time exporters.

50% of quality/export certification (such as CE) up to ₹50,000; 50% of testing cost up to ₹10,000 per shipment; 50% of country-specific certification up to ₹10,000 per shipment for new markets (first 3 years).
conditions: MSME exporters registered with the DIC, or merchant exporters with turnover under ₹5 crore
Valid IEC; one exhibition and one buyer-seller meet per year; not if central travel support was taken
Apply to Director, Export Promotion and Marketing, Odisha

items.name: Odisha Tourism Policy 2022 (amended 2026) – capital investment subsidy
items.summary: 30% capital subsidy for tourism units (up to ₹15 crore); 5% extra in backward areas and for women/SC/ST
details: Minimum investment ₹20 lakh, land excluded; paid one year after operations start, after valuer certification.
Tented accommodation 30% up to ₹15 lakh; adventure and water-sports equipment 25% up to ₹50 lakh.
Also 100% stamp duty and land-conversion charge reimbursement, 5-year electricity duty exemption and 50% of renewable energy installation cost.
The January 2026 amendment widened eligible units (wellness, eco-resorts, caravans, river cruises, Odia cuisine restaurants and more).
items.extraFor: 5% extra for women (51%+ equity), SC/ST and differently abled owners, and for projects in KBK, Kandhamal, Gajapati and Chilika areas
conditions: Sector: hotels, resorts, wellness, adventure and other notified tourism units (NIC 55, 56, 79, 93)
Unit must register with the Odisha Tourism Department
Apply through the Odisha Tourism Department / GO SWIFT

items.name: Odisha Tourism Policy 2022 – interest subsidy for tourism units
items.summary: 5% a year interest subsidy on term loans for 5 years, up to ₹1 crore
details: Starts one year after commercial operations begin.
conditions: Registered tourism units under the Odisha Tourism Policy (NIC 55, 56, 79, 93)
No default to banks, OSFC, IPICOL, SIDBI or other lenders
Apply through the Odisha Tourism Department

items.onlyText: Only for Scheduled Caste women's self-help groups
items.name: OSFDC Bankable Income Generating Scheme for SC women SHGs
items.summary: Back-end subsidy of 50% (up to ₹10,000 per member, ₹1.25 lakh per group) on bank loans to SC women SHGs
details: Run by Odisha SC and ST Development Finance Co-operative Corporation with Mission Shakti since Nov 2021.
Covers industry, service, business, vocational trades and allied activities; banks finance the loan.
Under revised PM-AJAY norms the subsidy can be up to ₹50,000 or 50% of asset cost per beneficiary.
conditions: SC women's self-help group in Odisha.
Apply through the OSFDC district office or Mission Shakti.

items.name: Odisha Procurement Preference Policy for Micro and Small Manufacturing Enterprises 2023
items.summary: Odisha MSEs within L1+10% get 25% of the order at own rate (else 15% at L1); tender fee and EMD exempt
details: Notified 24 Jan 2024 (No. 566/MSME), binding on all state procuring bodies, including purchases on GeM (Finance Dept OM of 10 Apr 2025).
Price preference: lowest Odisha MSE within L1+10% gets 25% of the quantity at its own rate.
Purchase preference: if no Odisha MSE is within L1+10%, the lowest one gets 15% of the quantity at the L1 rate.
Exclusive-list items are bought only from Odisha MSEs; rate-contract items from rate-contract holders.
Exempt from tender paper cost and EMD; turnover criteria cut by 90%; past experience waived; performance security at 25% of normal rate.
conditions: Manufacturing unit in Odisha with plant and machinery up to Rs 10 crore and turnover up to Rs 50 crore, with Udyam registration.
Submit the affidavit (Annexure-A) with the bid; goods must be self-manufactured.
Does not cover works, EPC or other services; Start-up Odisha manufacturing startups also qualify.
apply: MSME Department, Odisha / District Industries Centre

items.name: Mukhyamantri Bayan Shilpa Bikas Yojana (MBSBY), Odisha
items.summary: Rs 490 crore five-year scheme with incentives for new textile and handloom manufacturing units
details: Approved by the Odisha cabinet in December 2025; aligned with the Odisha Apparel and Technical Textiles Policy 2022.
Detailed incentive rates not confirmed from official text.
conditions: New textile or handloom manufacturing units in Odisha.
Apply to the Handlooms, Textiles and Handicrafts Department.
apply: Odisha Handlooms, Textiles and Handicrafts Department

states.statusText: Listed as current. The rates below are as announced in 2016; confirm the current G.O. rates with the Industries and Commerce Department.

portal.label: Industries and Commerce Department: subsidy and stamp-duty claim forms

states.zones: Mahe and Yanam were announced to get longer SGST and power benefits (7 years instead of 5).

items.name: Capital investment subsidy (2016 policy, as announced)
items.summary: As announced 2016: 40% for micro/small up to Rs 40 lakh; 35% for medium up to Rs 35 lakh.
details: As announced: micro & small 40% (cap Rs 40 lakh); medium & large 35% on land, building, plant & machinery (cap Rs 35 lakh); women/SC/ST entrepreneurs 45% (cap Rs 75 lakh).
Rates in the post-01-04-2017 subsidy G.O. ('capital intensive industries') unconfirmed.
items.extraFor: Women/SC/ST: 45%, cap Rs 75 lakh (as announced; unconfirmed)
conditions: Investments from 01-04-2017 fall under the newer subsidy G.O.
Service-sector eligibility unconfirmed

items.name: VAT/SGST reimbursement (2016 policy, as announced)
items.summary: As announced: 100% VAT/SGST reimbursement for small units, 5 years (Puducherry, Karaikal) or 7 years (Mahe, Yanam).
details: As announced: 100% for micro/small units, 5 years in Puducherry and Karaikal, 7 years in Mahe and Yanam; medium 75%; large 50%. How it operates after GST (2017) is unconfirmed.
conditions: Unconfirmed under current G.O.

items.name: Interest subsidy (2016 policy, as announced)
items.summary: As announced: 25% of annual interest on institutional loans for 5 years.
details: 25% of annual interest paid on institutional finance for fixed assets and working capital, for 5 years; cap unconfirmed.
conditions: Unconfirmed under current G.O.

items.name: Power cost reimbursement (2016 policy, as announced)
items.summary: As announced: 50 paise/unit power-cost reimbursement, 5 years (Puducherry, Karaikal) or 7 years (Mahe, Yanam).
details: Reimbursement of 50 paise per unit of power cost: 5 years in Puducherry and Karaikal, 7 years in Mahe and Yanam; caps unconfirmed.
conditions: Unconfirmed under current G.O.

items.name: Reimbursement of stamp duty
items.summary: Stamp duty paid by industrial units is reimbursed; applications invited 26-08-2025. Rate unconfirmed.
details: 2016 policy announced exemption on purchase, lease, mortgage or hypothecation of land, shed or building for industry; now run as reimbursement under a separate G.O. (applications invited 26-08-2025). Rate, cap and eligibility window unconfirmed.
conditions: Apply on the Department's stamp-duty reimbursement form

items.name: ZED certification subsidy
items.summary: UT subsidy for ZED certification listed by the Industries Department; amount unconfirmed.
details: Listed on the Documents/G.Os page (updated 26-08-2025) without a published rate.
conditions: Terms unconfirmed

items.name: MSME Mart registration incentive
items.summary: Incentive for registering on NSIC's MSME Mart e-marketplace listed by the Department; amount unconfirmed.
details: Listed on the Documents/G.Os page; terms not readable.
conditions: Terms unconfirmed

items.name: Motivation of Unemployed Persons to Start Self-Employed Enterprises (MUPSES)
items.summary: Bank loans of ₹10,000 to ₹2 lakh with 25% subsidy (max ₹25,000); 50% for projects up to ₹10,000
details: Subsidy of 50% of project cost for projects up to ₹10,000, and 25% (capped at ₹25,000) for projects above ₹10,000 and below ₹2 lakh; preliminary and pre-operative expenses excluded.
Loan at the normal bank rate; any viable service or industrial activity (laundry, beauty parlour, tailoring, tea stall and similar are encouraged). No family income limit.
conditions: Permanent resident of the area for at least 3 years; must be able to read and write; age as per bank norms.
Submit the State Loan application form to the District Industries Centre, Thattanchavady; quarterly interview, then forwarded to the bank.

items.name: Employment Incentive (Motivation of Entrepreneurs to Start Industries and Fiscal Assistance to Industries)
items.summary: 20% of PF-covered wages reimbursed, up to ₹5 lakh a year, for 5 years (7 years in Mahe and Yanam)
details: Subsidy equal to 20% of wages of PF-covered workers, ceiling ₹5 lakh per year, paid in one or more instalments subject to funds.
Runs 5 years in Puducherry and Karaikal regions and 7 years in Mahe and Yanam.
conditions: Investment on or after 1 Apr 2017; at least 10 direct employees and at least 60% of the workforce residents of Puducherry UT.

File the claim on the common subsidy application with the Directorate of Industries and Commerce within one year of production start or of completing expansion; no transfer of fixed assets for 5 years.
apply: Directorate of Industries and Commerce, Puducherry

items.name: Aspiring Puducherry Innovation and Startup Policy 2019 - seed grant and founder allowance
items.summary: Seed grant up to Rs 3 lakh for incubator-recommended startups and a monthly allowance of Rs 10,000 per founder (Rs 15,000 for women, SC, disabled or transgender)
details: Allowance covers up to five team members.
Marketing assistance for startups at the MVP stage (amount not confirmed); fast-tracked patent, trademark and design filings.
Run by the Department of Industries and Commerce; the 2019 policy stays in force beyond its original 2019-24 term.
items.extraFor: Monthly allowance of Rs 15,000 instead of Rs 10,000 for women, SC, disabled and transgender founders
conditions: Startup recognised under the Puducherry policy and recommended by a recognised incubator.
Apply through the Department of Industries and Commerce, Puducherry.
items.onlyText: Only for recognised startups recommended by an incubator

items.name: Grant of Financial Incentives for Hotels, Resorts and Tourism Projects (Puducherry)
items.summary: Capital incentive of Rs 2 to 3 lakh per room (caps Rs 30 lakh to Rs 1 crore) for classified hotels; 25% up to Rs 1 crore for big tourism projects
details: One-star hotels Rs 2 lakh per room up to Rs 30 lakh; two-star and heritage Rs 3 lakh per room up to Rs 75 lakh; three-star Rs 3 lakh per room up to Rs 1 crore.
Hotels above three-star, theme parks, marinas, convention centres and cruise projects: 25% of capital investment up to Rs 1 crore.
Service apartments: Rs 1 lakh (Silver, up to Rs 6 lakh) or Rs 2 lakh (Gold, up to Rs 12 lakh) per apartment.
conditions: Hotel must have star or heritage classification from the Ministry of Tourism; heritage buildings must be on the Puducherry heritage list.
No other capital subsidy for the same project; keep the same name and style for 8 years (undertaking on stamp paper).
Apply offline to the Department of Tourism, Puducherry; a committee approves and may release in instalments.
apply: Scheme page (apply to Department of Tourism, Puducherry)

states.short: Punjab Industrial and Business Development Policy 2026
states.statusText: Notified 8 Mar 2026. MSME-level rates for SGST, electricity duty, stamp duty and interest are not yet confirmed; the two items below come from news and consultant summaries.

portal.label: Invest Punjab

states.zones: Border districts and Kandi (sub-mountain) areas get 25% extra.
states.notes: Replaced IBDP 2022. A separate Retail Investment and Modernization Policy 2026 may help traders.

items.name: Capital subsidy and flexible incentive menu
items.summary: New capital subsidy; investors choose from about 20 incentives, worth up to 100% of FCI over up to 15 years.
details: MSME-specific rates, caps and thresholds unconfirmed.
Border districts and Kandi areas: 25% extra incentives (reported for nine thrust sectors).
Sep 2026: amendments approved that extend concessions to existing units (details unconfirmed).
conditions: Covers new units, expansion and modernisation (reported)
Services eligibility is sector-specific (hotels, hospitals and film studios reported)

items.name: Employment generation subsidy
items.summary: Available from ₹25 crore investment with 50+ workers; higher rate for hiring women, SC/ST and persons with disabilities.
details: Per-employee amounts unconfirmed; the threshold rules out most micro and small units.
items.extraFor: Higher subsidy for employing women, SC/ST and persons with disabilities
conditions: Minimum ₹25 crore investment and 50 employees

items.name: Electricity duty exemption (Industrial and Business Development Policy 2026)
items.summary: 100% electricity duty exemption from date of commercial production, within an annual ceiling
details: Covers electricity duty only; IDF and social security fund charges are not exempt.
Policy applies for 5 years from 8 Mar 2026; ceiling amount not confirmed.
conditions: New units or existing units doing expansion, registered online with the Department of Industries.
Udyam registration for MSMEs; registered lease deed if premises are rented.
Bronze ZED certificate needed for post-production incentives.
apply: Punjab Department of Industries and Commerce (Invest Punjab)

items.name: Direct Lending Scheme (Punjab SC Land Development and Finance Corporation)
items.summary: Direct loans up to ₹10 lakh at 5-8% interest for Scheduled Caste entrepreneurs; BPL borrowers get a subsidy up to ₹10,000
details: Loan of up to ₹10 lakh to set up a unit (up to ₹30 lakh for land purchase).
Interest 5% on loans up to ₹50,000 and 8% above ₹50,000; flexible monthly to half-yearly repayment.
BPL SC borrowers get special central assistance of 50% of the loan or ₹10,000, whichever is lower.
Loan paid directly to the borrower's bank account by RTGS.
conditions: Scheduled Caste resident of Punjab aged 18 to 55; annual income limit ₹1 lakh (family income can be disregarded for unemployed applicants starting a business).
Get the free form from the corporation's district office; a screening committee chaired by the ADC (D) checks the case and the head office sanctions it; mortgage deed required.
items.onlyText: Only for Scheduled Caste residents of Punjab aged 18 to 55 with income up to ₹1 lakh
Only for Backward Classes, Economically Weaker Sections and minority communities
items.name: Punjab Backfinco loans for backward classes and minorities (Direct Lending, NBCFDC and NMDFC schemes)
items.summary: Self-employment loans at 4% to 6%: term loans up to ₹5 lakh (BC) and ₹10 lakh (minorities)
details: Direct Lending Scheme at 6% for Backward Classes and EWS with family income under ₹1 lakh.
NBCFDC General Loan up to ₹5 lakh at 6%; New Swarnima for BC women up to ₹2 lakh at 5%.
NMDFC Term Loan for minorities up to ₹10 lakh (5% up to ₹50,000, 6% above); SHG micro-finance up to ₹1 lakh per member at 4% to 5%.
conditions: Member of a notified Backward Class, EWS or minority community resident in Punjab.
Apply at the Backfinco district office.

items.name: Punjab Food Processing Policy 2026 (sectoral policy under IBDP 2026)
items.summary: Food processing package: total incentives up to 125% of fixed capital investment, capped at ₹500 crore
details: Notified on 8 Mar 2026 (No. PIU/IBDP-2026/Sectoral Policies/907) with 23 other sector policies.
Total incentives can reach up to 125% of fixed capital investment, capped at ₹500 crore; component rates are in the policy document.
conditions: Food processing units in Punjab registered with the Department of Industries; Udyam registration for MSMEs.
Post-production incentives need a ZED Bronze certificate; apply within 12 months after the financial year of the claim.

items.name: Punjab Logistics and Warehousing Policy 2026
items.summary: 20% capital subsidy up to ₹10 crore for logistics parks and cold chain; stamp duty, electricity duty and CLU exemptions
details: Capital subsidy of up to 20% of fixed capital investment, maximum ₹10 crore, for logistics parks, multi-modal logistics parks and cold chain facilities.
Warehouses (at least 30,000 sq ft, not for own use) get an employment generation subsidy for 5 years.
100% exemption from electricity duty, stamp duty on land or building purchase or lease, and change of land use charges.
conditions: Notified 8 Mar 2026 with the IBDP 2026 sector policies; expansion of existing units is not eligible.
Logistics parks need at least 20 acres and ₹25 crore investment; total incentives capped at 100% of FCI or ₹500 crore.
Apply online through the Invest Punjab Business First portal.

items.name: Punjab Textiles and Apparel, Spinning and Weaving, and Dyeing and Finishing Policies 2026
items.summary: Three textile sector incentive packages under IBDP 2026; rates not confirmed
details: Notified on 8 Mar 2026 (No. PIU/IBDP-2026/Sectoral Policies/907) as sector policies under the Industrial and Business Development Policy 2026.
Separate packages for textiles and apparel, spinning and weaving, and dyeing and finishing units; amount not confirmed.
conditions: Textile units in Punjab registered with the Department of Industries; Udyam registration for MSMEs.
Apply through the Invest Punjab Business First portal.

items.name: Punjab Farm Stay Policy 2026
items.summary: Capital subsidy up to 10% (cap Rs 5 crore), SGST reimbursement, domestic power tariff and CLU fee exemption for farm stays
details: Registered farm stays can get capital subsidy up to 10% of project investment (reported cap Rs 5 crore) and SGST reimbursement (reported 75%).
Electricity at domestic tariff, exemption from change-of-land-use fees, statutory audit support, and free hospitality training for the owner and at least three staff.
Support for solar and biogas systems. Issued by the Department of Tourism and Cultural Affairs on 15 May 2026.
conditions: At least 1 acre of agricultural land owned by the applicant; owner or family must live on the property
2 to 9 guest rooms (max 18 beds), at least two rural activities for guests, construction up to 10% of the land
Apply online on the FastTrack Punjab portal; registration for 5 years

items.name: Preference to Make in Punjab Order 2019 (purchase preference to local suppliers)
items.summary: Local suppliers within 15% of L1 can get purchase preference for up to 50% of quantity
details: Local suppliers quoting within 15% of the lowest bid can get purchase preference for up to 50% of the quantity.
Local content of ordinarily at least 40% is needed; departments can set a different share for some items.
Procuring entities should keep turnover and capacity conditions from unreasonably excluding local suppliers. Startups are also exempt from prior experience and turnover conditions in state tenders.
conditions: Supplier with goods made in Punjab meeting the local-content share.
Claim local-supplier status in the tender of the Punjab department or body.

items.name: Punjab startup incentives (Startup Punjab, Industrial and Business Development Policy 2022)
items.summary: Seed grant up to Rs 3 lakh, lease rent 25% up to Rs 3 lakh/yr, interest subsidy 8% up to Rs 5 lakh/yr
details: Seed grant up to Rs 3 lakh per startup for validation, prototype and early setup.
Lease rental subsidy of 25% for one year in incubators, IT parks or clusters, up to Rs 3 lakh a year.
Interest subsidy of 8% a year for 5 years, up to Rs 5 lakh a year.
100% reimbursement of stamp duty on MoA/AoA registration.
Whether these continue unchanged under the 2026 policy is not confirmed.
items.extraFor: Women-owned businesses get 5% interest subsidy on term loans.
conditions: Startup registered on the Startup Punjab portal.
Apply through Startup Punjab / Invest Punjab.

states.short: RIPS 2024 MSME package with the MSME Policy 2024
states.statusText: In force.

portal.label: Rajnivesh single window (log in with Rajasthan SSO)

states.zones: The MSME package is the same across the state.
states.notes: All MSME incentives together are capped at ₹5 crore a year. Agro and food processing gets a 50% capital subsidy (max ₹1.5 crore) and plastic alternatives 50% (max ₹40 lakh).

items.name: Investment subsidy (reimbursement of state GST)
items.summary: 75% of state GST due and deposited is reimbursed for 10 years.
details: RIPS clause 3.4.2.1. All MSME incentives together are capped at ₹5 crore a year. MSMEs with EFCI above ₹25 crore may choose the large-enterprise package instead.
conditions: Service MSMEs qualify only for services listed in Annexure 9.5
Ineligible sectors in Annexure 9.2; trading is not covered
Production must start within the policy period or within 2 years of the Entitlement Certificate

items.name: Interest subvention (RIPS 2024) plus MSME Policy top-up
items.summary: Interest subvention for 7 years: 6% on loans up to ₹5 crore, 4% on ₹5–10 crore, 3% on ₹10–50 crore.
details: Slabs are telescoped, on loans for plant, machinery or equipment. Khadi units get 10 years. Loans up to ₹25 lakh for rural-tourism and agro-based units get an extra 1%.
MSME Policy 2024: selected new or expansion projects may get a further 2%/1%/0.5% on the same slabs, approved by district or state task forces.
conditions: Counts toward the ₹5 crore annual MSME cap

items.name: EPF/ESI reimbursement
items.summary: 50% of the employer's EPF and ESI contribution reimbursed for 7 years for Rajasthan-domiciled employees.
details: RIPS clause 3.4.2.3. Training support: 50% of training cost for up to 6 months, capped at ₹20,000 / ₹30,000 / ₹40,000 a month for micro / small / medium.
