conditions: Domiciled employees only

items.name: Electricity duty exemption
items.summary: 100% electricity duty exemption for 7 years.
details: RIPS clause 3.4.2.4. Agro units also get 100% reimbursement of mandi/market fee for 7 years.

items.name: Stamp duty and land-conversion charges
items.summary: Stamp duty 75% exempt plus the other 25% reimbursed (effectively 100%); the same applies to land-conversion charges.
details: RIPS clause 3.4.2.4. There is no land-tax exemption in the MSME package.

items.name: Technology acquisition and quality certification (MSME Policy 2024)
items.summary: One-time 50% of technology acquisition cost (max ₹5 lakh); 50% of certification costs (max ₹3 lakh).
details: Certifications covered: BIS, FSSAI, ISO, ZED and IPR.
conditions: No similar benefit may be claimed under another state policy

items.name: Trade fairs, e-commerce and SME listing (MSME Policy 2024)
items.summary: Trade fairs: 75% of stall rent (₹37,500–₹1.5 lakh per event). E-commerce fees and digitisation: 75% each, max ₹50,000.
details: Per year: fairs in Rajasthan ₹37,500 (3 events), elsewhere in India ₹1,12,500 (2), abroad ₹1,50,000 (1), plus travel for two. After use, that category is barred for 2 years.
SME-exchange listing: up to ₹15 lakh (MSME Policy); RIPS pays 50% of costs up to ₹5 lakh.

items.name: Dr. Bhimrao Ambedkar Rajasthan Dalit, Adivasi Udyam Protsahan Yojana (BRUPY)
items.summary: SC/ST entrepreneurs: 25% margin-money subsidy (max ₹25 lakh) plus 6–9% interest subsidy on bank loans.
details: Interest subsidy: 9% on loans up to ₹25 lakh, 7% on ₹25 lakh–₹5 crore, 6% on ₹5–10 crore. The state pays the CGTMSE guarantee fee.
items.extraFor: SC/ST only
conditions: Subsidy tenure, trading eligibility and expansion eligibility unconfirmed
items.onlyText: Only for SC/ST entrepreneurs

items.name: Vishwakarma Yuva Udyami Protsahan Yojana (VYUPY)
items.summary: Loans up to ₹2 crore with 8% interest subsidy (7% above ₹1 crore) for 5 years, plus margin money up to ₹5 lakh
details: Interest subsidy 8% on loans up to ₹1 crore and 7% on ₹1-2 crore, for up to 5 years.
Margin money: 25% of loan or ₹5 lakh, whichever is lower, adjusted after three years of operation.
Covers new units and expansion, diversification or modernisation of existing MSEs; scheme valid to 31 Mar 2029.
items.extraFor: Extra 1% interest subsidy for women, SC, ST, divyang, rural enterprises, registered weavers and artisans
conditions: Rajasthan resident aged 18 to 45; not a bank defaulter.
At least 10% own contribution; firms need at least 51% ownership by the eligible youth.
Apply on the Rajasthan SSO portal (Industries and Commerce Department).
items.onlyText: Only entrepreneurs aged 18 to 45

items.name: Rajasthan Startup Policy 2022 (iStart) incentives
items.summary: Ideation grant up to ₹2.4 lakh (plus ₹60,000 for women-led), and reimbursement of patent and marketing costs up to ₹5 lakh each
details: Ideation (pre-seed) grant of up to ₹2.4 lakh; viability (seed) grant and Scale-Up Fund (up to 50% of amount raised, convertible from debt to grant) linked to the QRate score.
Reimbursement of patent filing up to ₹5 lakh, marketing up to ₹5 lakh and quality certification up to ₹25 lakh.
Event participation support of ₹50,000 (national) and ₹5 lakh (international).
Matching equity of up to ₹5 crore per startup through the Startup Equity Fund (AIF).
items.extraFor: Extra ₹60,000 ideation grant booster for startups with over 50% women founders' equity
conditions: Startup registered on iStart Rajasthan (DoIT&C) and rated under QRate.
Apply on the iStart Rajasthan portal.
items.onlyText: Only for startups registered on iStart Rajasthan

items.name: Rajasthan ODOP Policy 2024: margin money for new ODOP micro and small units
items.summary: Margin money grant of 25% of project cost up to Rs 15 lakh (micro) or 15% up to Rs 20 lakh (small)
details: New micro ODOP units: 25% of eligible project cost, up to Rs 15 lakh. New small units: 15%, up to Rs 20 lakh.
Released after the bank disburses a loan at least equal to the grant.
items.extraFor: Extra up to Rs 5 lakh for units owned by women, SC/ST, persons with disability or entrepreneurs under 35
conditions: Unit must make or serve the district's declared ODOP product (at least 50% of turnover)
Approved by the District Industries and Commerce Centre (GM DICC)
Policy valid to 31 Mar 2029
items.onlyText: Only for units making the district's notified ODOP product
apply: Apply online with Rajasthan SSO ID or e-Mitra

items.name: Rajasthan ODOP Policy 2024: technology, certification, fairs and e-commerce support
items.summary: 50% tech up to Rs 5 lakh, 75% certification/IPR up to Rs 3 lakh, fair stall aid up to Rs 2 lakh, e-commerce fees
details: Technology or software from government institutes: 50% up to Rs 5 lakh (micro and small). BIS, FSSAI, ISO, ZED and IPR costs: 75% up to Rs 3 lakh one-time.

Fairs: 75% of stall rent up to Rs 50,000 in Rajasthan, Rs 1.5 lakh in other states and Rs 2 lakh abroad, plus travel for two. E-commerce fees: 75% up to Rs 1 lakh a year for 2 years; catalogue or website: 60% up to Rs 75,000.
conditions: ODOP MSME (at least 50% of turnover from the district's ODOP product), new or existing
No similar benefit under another state policy
Apply online (ODOPRAJ / SSO); policy valid to 31 Mar 2029
items.onlyText: Only for units making the district's notified ODOP product
apply: Apply online with Rajasthan SSO ID or e-Mitra

items.name: Rajasthan Export Promotion Policy 2024: freight, export credit insurance, marketing and certification support
items.summary: 25% freight up to Rs 25 lakh/yr, 50% ECGC premium up to Rs 2 lakh, 75% fair costs up to Rs 3 lakh, e-commerce fees
details: Freight: 25% of export freight through state ICDs or air cargo, up to Rs 25 lakh per unit a year, for first-time exporters (MSMEs including existing units). ECGC premium: 50% up to Rs 2 lakh a year for MSME exporters.

Fairs and buyer-seller meets: 75% up to Rs 3 lakh a year (once in two years). Documentation, certification and testing: 50% up to Rs 5 lakh a year; product testing 75% up to Rs 20,000 a shipment. E-commerce export fees: 75% up to Rs 2 lakh for 2 years. Technology acquisition: 75% up to Rs 50 lakh (reported raised to Rs 1 crore in 2026).
conditions: Exporter with IEC and RCMC, unit registered in Rajasthan
No duplicate claim under other schemes
Apply online via SSO; policy valid to 31 Mar 2029
apply: Apply online with Rajasthan SSO ID or e-Mitra

items.name: RIPS 2024: capital subsidy for agro and food processing units
items.summary: Capital subsidy of 50% of investment up to Rs 1.5 crore for agro and food processing MSMEs, plus mandi fee reimbursement
details: Agro and food processing enterprises get capital subsidy of 50% of capital investment, up to Rs 1.5 crore, and an extra 1% interest subvention.
100% mandi fee reimbursement for 7 years under RIPS 2024 packages.
items.extraFor: Extra 5% capital subsidy for FPOs owned by SC/ST or women, and units in Tribal Sub-Plan areas
conditions: FPOs and producer companies need at least 50 farmer members
Commercial production within the RIPS operative period (to 31 Mar 2029)
Apply for an entitlement certificate on the Rajasthan single window via SSO
apply: Apply online with Rajasthan SSO ID or e-Mitra

items.name: RIPS 2024: green growth incentives for MSMEs
items.summary: 50% of environmental project cost up to Rs 1 crore, 10% clean-tech machinery support, ED waiver on captive renewable power
details: 50% reimbursement of environmental infrastructure such as ETP, waste management and water conservation, up to Rs 1 crore for MSMEs (shared with clean-tech support).
10% support on clean-technology machinery, 100% electricity duty exemption on captive renewable energy for 7 years, and 50% consent fee waiver under the Rajasthan Green Rating System.
conditions: MSME registered under RIPS 2024
Operative to 31 Mar 2029
Apply via the Rajasthan single window (SSO)
apply: Apply online with Rajasthan SSO ID or e-Mitra

items.name: RIPS 2024: employee training reimbursement for MSMEs
items.summary: 50% of staff training cost for 6 months, up to Rs 20,000/month (micro), Rs 30,000 (small), Rs 40,000 (medium)
details: One-time reimbursement of 50% of the cost of training employees at an accredited institution for six months.
conditions: MSME under RIPS 2024; training from an accredited institution
Apply via the Rajasthan single window (SSO)
apply: Apply online with Rajasthan SSO ID or e-Mitra

items.name: Rajasthan Integrated Cluster Development Policy 2024: Common Facility Centres and cluster infrastructure
items.summary: State grant of 80% (90% for SC/ST/women/ODOP clusters) of CFC cost up to Rs 10 crore; 8% interest subsidy for raw material banks
details: CFC projects: 80% grant on project cost up to Rs 10 crore; 90% if over half the SPV units are SC/ST or women owned, or ODOP. RIICO land for CFCs at 25% of industrial rate.
Raw material bank: 8% interest subsidy on loans up to Rs 50 lakh. Soft interventions: 100% grant up to Rs 50 lakh per cluster. Infrastructure for existing clusters: 80% grant up to Rs 8 crore.
items.extraFor: 90% CFC grant where over 50% of SPV units are SC/ST or women owned
conditions: SPV of cluster units contributes at least 20% (10% in SC/ST/women case)
Application to GM DICC with DSR/DPR; approval by Project Approval Committee
Policy valid to 31 Mar 2029
items.onlyText: Only for cluster SPVs and implementing agencies
apply: Apply through the District Industries and Commerce Centre

items.name: Rajasthan Integrated Cluster Development Policy 2024: e-commerce sales incentive for artisans and enterprises
items.summary: One-time 20% incentive on annual e-commerce sales, up to Rs 50,000 per artisan or enterprise
details: Pays 20% of annual e-commerce sales as a one-time incentive, capped at Rs 50,000.
conditions: Cluster artisan or enterprise with at least Rs 1 lakh annual e-commerce turnover
Apply through GM DICC; policy valid to 31 Mar 2029
apply: Apply through the District Industries and Commerce Centre

items.name: RFC Saral Loan Scheme (Rajasthan Financial Corporation)
items.summary: RFC term loans up to ₹10 crore (companies) or ₹8 crore (others) for existing MSMEs, repayable over up to 7 years
details: For running MSME units against the existing land and building mortgage plus hypothecation of plant and new fixed assets.
conditions: Existing MSME unit operating for at least six months.
Apply online or at an RFC branch office.

items.name: Mukhyamantri Nari Shakti Udyam Protsahan Yojana (MNSUPY)
items.summary: Bank loans up to Rs 50 lakh (Rs 1 crore for clusters) with 25% subsidy; 30% for SC/ST, widows and disabled women
details: Run by the Women Empowerment Department, Rajasthan; replaces the Indira Mahila Shakti Udyam Protsahan Yojana.
Loans up to Rs 50 lakh for individual women or SHGs and up to Rs 1 crore for clusters or federations, for industry, services, trade, dairy and agro enterprises.
Subsidy of 25% of the loan; 30% for SC/ST, widows, deserted or violence-affected women and women with disabilities.
items.extraFor: 30% subsidy for SC/ST, widows, deserted or violence-affected women and women with disabilities.
conditions: Woman aged 18 or above, resident of Rajasthan, or a registered SHG, cluster or federation.
Apply online on the Rajasthan SSO portal; the department recommends and the bank sanctions the loan.
Existing units seeking expansion need Udyam registration.
items.onlyText: Only for women entrepreneurs and women SHGs or federations

items.name: RIPS 2024: capital or interest subsidy for warehouses, cold storage and logistics infrastructure
items.summary: 25% capital subsidy for warehouses and silos (20% cold storage), or 7% interest subvention for 7 years, plus tracking and software aid
details: Capital subsidy of 25% for warehouses, silos, logistics parks, ICDs, CFS, cargo terminals and truckers' parks; 20% for cold storage. Annual cap Rs 15 crore for warehouses, silos and cold storage.
Or 7% interest subvention on term loans for 7 years (annual ceiling Rs 0.5 crore for warehouses).
50% of GPS tracking device cost (up to Rs 2,000 per Rajasthan-registered truck), 50% of logistics management software cost (up to Rs 2 lakh) and 20% of fire detection system cost (up to Rs 10 lakh).
conditions: Choose either the capital subsidy or the interest subvention
Minimum investment differs by facility type
Apply on Rajasthan Single Window (Rajnivesh) portal

items.name: Rajasthan preference to state MSMEs in public procurement (RTPP Act 2012 and Rules 2013)
items.summary: 96 items reserved for Rajasthan MSEs; bid security 0.5%, performance security 1%, tender document at 50% cost
details: 96 items are reserved for mandatory procurement from micro and small enterprises of Rajasthan.
Purchase preference for MSMEs in items outside the reserved schedule, with a target of 80% procurement from local MSMEs.
Departments can buy goods worth up to Rs 10 lakh a year directly from empanelled Rajasthan MSMEs through E-Bazaar without a tender.
Bid security of 0.5% and performance security of 1% for MSMEs; tender documents at 50% of cost.
items.extraFor: 4% reservation for SC/ST entrepreneurs in procurement.
conditions: MSME located in Rajasthan with Udyam registration.
Benefits apply in tenders of Rajasthan departments under the RTPP Act; register on E-Bazaar for direct purchase.

states.statusText: In force. Figures come from the state's RAMP plan summary, and two items are unverified. The Industrial and Investment Policy 2024 may add to them.

portal.label: Commerce and Industries Department

states.zones: Rates are the same across the state.
states.notes: Some benefits are limited to holders of a COI, Sikkim Subject or Residential Certificate.

items.name: Stamp duty exemption and transfer duty reimbursement
items.summary: 100% stamp duty exemption for new enterprises; transfer duty reimbursed up to Rs 2 lakh.
details: New enterprises: 100% exemption from stamp duty.
Transfer duty reimbursed up to Rs 2 lakh, only for COI / Sikkim Subject / Residential Certificate holders.
conditions: New enterprises only
Transfer-duty reimbursement limited to COI/Sikkim Subject/Residential Certificate holders
Udyam registration required

items.name: SGST reimbursement
items.summary: 50% of SGST reimbursed for 3 years from commercial production; total cap Rs 2 lakh.
details: Manufacturing, service and job-work MSMEs: 50% of SGST for 3 years from commencement of commercial production, maximum Rs 2 lakh.
ICAI compilation only (unconfirmed): expansion 70% (micro/small) or 50% (medium) for 5 years; women +15%.
items.extraFor: Women +15% (ICAI compilation only; unconfirmed)
conditions: Counted from commencement of commercial production
Expansion terms unconfirmed

items.name: Interest subsidy
items.summary: 25% interest subsidy on enterprise loans for the first 5 years, max Rs 2 lakh per year.
details: 25% of interest on credit loans availed for enterprise development, first 5 years, capped at Rs 2 lakh per year.
ICAI adds (unconfirmed): regular repayment required; not available if a similar central interest subsidy is availed.
conditions: First 5 years only
Loan must be for enterprise development

items.name: Trade fair, export logistics and procurement support
items.summary: Trade fairs: 50% of transport cost; exports: 50% (seaport) or 30% (airport) of logistics expenses.
details: National/international trade fairs: 50% of transportation cost.
Exports: 50% of logistic expenses via seaports or 30% via airports; also 50% transport, 50% warehouse and 25% packaging cost.
State tenders: 15% price preference, tender fee waived, EMD exempt for MSEs.
conditions: Export support per shipment; RCMC required per ICAI (unconfirmed)
Procurement preferences for micro and small enterprises

items.name: Green audits, DPR, R&D and quality/IPR support
items.summary: 50% of energy/water audit cost (max Rs 1 lakh); 50% of DPR cost up to Rs 20,000.
details: Water/energy audit: 50% or max Rs 1 lakh, for 3 years; greenery creation 50% up to Rs 1 lakh (one-time).
DPR by empanelled agency: 50% up to Rs 20,000.
R&D at national institutes: State bears up to Rs 50,000 (local entrepreneurs).
Quality certification/patent/trademark assistance: amount unconfirmed.
conditions: R&D support for local entrepreneurs only

items.name: Reserved estate space and procurement sub-target
items.summary: 20% of flatted-factory/industrial-estate area reserved for women, PwD, SC/ST and rural entrepreneurs.
details: 20% of flatted factory / industrial estate area reserved for women, PwD, SC/ST and rural entrepreneurs.
State procurement: 25% annual target from MSEs, including a 5% sub-target for women/PwD/SC/ST/rural enterprises.
items.extraFor: Women, persons with disability, SC/ST, rural entrepreneurs
conditions: Procurement sub-target applies to micro and small enterprises
items.onlyText: For women, persons with disability, SC/ST and rural entrepreneurs

items.name: Fixed capital subsidy (reported, unverified)
items.summary: Reported only: 10% (micro, max Rs 5 lakh) or 20% (small/medium, max Rs 50 lakh) of plant and machinery.
details: ICAI compilation only, absent from the official RAMP summary: manufacturing 10% of P&M for micro (max Rs 5 lakh), 20% for small/medium (max Rs 50 lakh); services 10% of equipment (max Rs 5 lakh micro, Rs 20 lakh small/medium); +5% women/SC/ST; land excluded.
items.extraFor: +5% for women and SC/ST (unconfirmed)
conditions: Unconfirmed - verify with the Department before use

items.name: Power cost reimbursement (reported, unverified)
items.summary: Reported only: Rs 1.00 per unit power-cost reimbursement for 5 years; 50% of DG-set cost.
details: ICAI compilation only: Rs 1 per unit for 5 years from commencement (captive power plants excluded); one-time 50% of DG set cost excluding installation. Not in the official RAMP summary.
conditions: Unconfirmed - verify with the Department before use

items.name: Skilled Youth Start-up Scheme (SYSS)
items.summary: Bank-loan-linked back-ended subsidy of 35% (50% for BPL and PwD) on projects up to ₹20 lakh
details: Run by the Commerce & Industries Department through the District Industries Centres since 2020.
Project caps vary by activity: e.g. ₹10 lakh for food processing, manufacturing, IT and retail; ₹15 lakh for homestays, bakeries and restaurants; ₹20 lakh for diagnostic centres.
Mandatory 3-day entrepreneurship training before loan disbursement; lock-in of 3 years (1 year for agriculture-allied).
items.extraFor: BPL applicants and persons with disabilities get 50% subsidy instead of 35%
conditions: Sikkim COI, Sikkim Subject or residential certificate; unemployed; at least Class V pass
Age 18 to 45; one member per family; family income up to ₹8 lakh a year; not a bank defaulter; no earlier CMSS or PMEGP subsidy
Submit form with DPR to the GM, DIC (Gangtok or Jorethang); selection committee forwards to bank
items.onlyText: Only for unemployed Sikkim youth aged 18 to 45 with family income up to ₹8 lakh
apply: District Industries Centre, Commerce & Industries Department

items.name: Sikkim Startup Policy 2024
items.summary: One-time ₹1 lakh grant, lease rent support up to ₹3 lakh over 3 years, patent reimbursement up to ₹5 lakh, SGST refund up to ₹5 lakh
details: Seed funding for startups in key sectors and a one-time ₹1 lakh grant for Sikkim-based startups.
100% patent filing reimbursement up to ₹5 lakh; 50% R&D expense reimbursement up to ₹5 lakh; quality certification reimbursement for 3 years.
SGST reimbursement for up to 3 years, capped at ₹5 lakh per startup.
₹1 lakh a year for 3 years for startups with at least 90% local staff, or employing women, transgender persons or persons with disabilities.
items.extraFor: Women-led startups (two-thirds female leadership) get up to ₹3 lakh extra
conditions: Startup recognised under the Sikkim Startup Policy and based in Sikkim
Apply through the Commerce & Industries Department, Government of Sikkim
items.onlyText: Only for startups recognised by the Government of Sikkim

items.name: RAMP reimbursement schemes: Logistics and Insurance Coverage, and Green Initiative (Sikkim)
items.summary: Reimbursement of transport and insurance costs, and support for green tech, energy efficiency and waste management; rates not confirmed
details: Logistics and Insurance Coverage Reimbursement Scheme: reimburses eligible MSMEs' transport and insurance costs.
Green Initiative Reimbursement Scheme: financial assistance for adopting green technology, energy-efficient systems or waste management.
Run under the central RAMP programme by the Commerce and Industries Department; briefed to entrepreneurs on 11 Feb 2026.
conditions: Udyam-registered MSME in Sikkim.
Apply to the Commerce and Industries Department, Sikkim, with the prescribed documents.

states.statusText: In force; its schemes are restated in the MSME Department Policy Note 2025-26. A new government took office in May 2026, so watch for a revised policy.

portal.label: MSME Online, Commissionerate of Industries and Commerce

states.zones: Micro units get the capital subsidy anywhere. Small and medium units get it only in the 254 industrially backward blocks or government estates, except agro and food processing and thrust sectors.
states.notes: The policy uses older size limits (plant and machinery ₹1/10/50 crore). Other state schemes include UYEGP, Kalaignar Kaivinai Thittam for artisans and the TN Credit Guarantee Scheme.

items.name: Capital subsidy
items.summary: 25% of plant and machinery value: micro up to ₹25 lakh anywhere; small/medium up to ₹1.5 crore.
details: Micro: any block, plus an extra 10% ≤₹5L (new or expanding micro). Small/medium: only in the 254 backward blocks or government estates; agro/food processing in any block; thrust sectors 25% ≤₹1.5 Cr anywhere; paid in 3 instalments. Existing MSEs scaling up: +5% ≤₹25L. Cleaner technology: 25% ≤₹10L.
items.extraFor: Women/SC/ST/differently-abled/transgender: +5% (separate entry)
conditions: Manufacturing only; service enterprises excluded
Apply within 1 year of commercial production
26-sector negative list (e.g., sugar, distilleries, cement, tobacco)

items.name: Additional capital subsidy for special categories
items.summary: Extra 5% of plant and machinery value, up to ₹5 lakh, for women, SC/ST, differently-abled and transgender entrepreneurs.
details: New micro units anywhere; new small/medium units in the 254 backward blocks; agro-based units in all 388 blocks.
items.extraFor: Women, SC/ST, differently-abled, transgender
conditions: The compendium says new units only; the 2021 policy suggests expansion also qualifies
items.onlyText: Only for women, SC/ST, differently-abled or transgender entrepreneurs

items.name: Low Tension Power Tariff (LTPT) subsidy
items.summary: 20% of LT power charges for the first 36 months for micro manufacturers.
details: Runs from production start or power connection. Low Tension Tariff III-B consumers only.
conditions: Service activities excluded

items.name: Back-ended interest subsidy
items.summary: 5% interest subsidy on term loans for 5 years, max ₹20 lakh (loans up to ₹2 crore).
details: 2021 policy: technology upgradation/modernisation loans up to ₹5 Cr get up to ₹25L; CGTMSE-covered loans up to ₹2 Cr get up to ₹20L; paid quarterly. EV-component micro/small units: 6% on TIIC loans (new units).

items.name: Stamp duty concessions
items.summary: 50% of stamp duty and registration charges; 100% on mortgage documents for micro units.
details: 50% rebate on plots bought in government industrial estates. 50% reimbursement in the 254 backward blocks, claimed within 6 months of production. 100% on mortgage/pledge documents for micro units.

items.name: Pay-roll subsidy
items.summary: Employer EPF contribution reimbursed for the first 3 years, up to ₹24,000 per employee per year.
details: Micro units anywhere; all MSMEs in the backward blocks. Minimum 20 employees.
conditions: New enterprises only

items.name: Quality certification, patents and energy audit
items.summary: Quality certification 100% up to ₹2 lakh (national)/₹10 lakh (international); patents 75% up to ₹3 lakh.
details: Covers ISO, HACCP, GMP, BIS, ZED and similar. Trademark/GI: 50% ≤₹25,000 (manufacturing units). Energy audit 75% ≤₹1L; implementing its recommendations 50% ≤₹10L.
conditions: Quality certification: travel and surveillance charges excluded

items.name: Trade fair support
items.summary: 50% of stall charges at international trade fairs, up to ₹15 lakh.
details: Exhibitions run by MSME associations: 50% of hall rent, up to ₹7.5L (Chennai) or ₹1.5L (districts).

items.name: Annal Ambedkar Business Champions Scheme (AABCS)
items.summary: SC/ST entrepreneurs: 35% capital subsidy up to ₹1 crore plus 6% interest subvention.
details: Open to both new and existing enterprises.
items.extraFor: SC/ST only
conditions: Activity scope and project-cost limits unconfirmed
items.onlyText: Only for SC/ST entrepreneurs

items.name: NEEDS (New Entrepreneur-cum-Enterprise Development Scheme)
items.summary: First-generation educated entrepreneurs: 25% capital subsidy up to ₹75 lakh plus 3% interest subvention.
details: Project cost ₹10L-₹5 Cr. Age 21-35 (general) or 21-45 (special categories). Needs 12th standard, diploma or ITI, and 3 years' residence in Tamil Nadu.
items.extraFor: 50% of beneficiaries reserved for women; age relaxation for special categories
conditions: New enterprises only

items.name: Unemployed Youth Employment Generation Programme (UYEGP)
items.summary: Bank loan up to ₹15 lakh with state subsidy of 25% of project cost, capped at ₹3.75 lakh
details: For educated unemployed people from weaker sections to start their own manufacturing, service or business ventures.
State subsidy of up to 25% of project cost, maximum ₹3.75 lakh; the scheme is running in FY 2025-26 (portal dashboard updated March 2026).
conditions: Age, education and family income limits apply; check the portal before applying.
Apply online on the TN MSME online portal; the District Industries Centre interviews and recommends to banks.
items.onlyText: Only for educated unemployed youth from socially and economically weaker sections

items.name: Kalaignar Kaivinai Thittam (KKT) - artisans and traditional trades
items.summary: Collateral-free loan of Rs 50,000 to Rs 3 lakh with 25% subsidy (max Rs 50,000) and up to 5% interest subvention
details: For artisans in 25 traditional trades such as carpentry, pottery, weaving, tailoring, leatherwork, hairdressing, laundry and boat building.
Subsidy of 25% of the loan (up to Rs 50,000) is released after skill and entrepreneurship training; interest subvention brings the effective rate to about 5%.
Credit guarantee cover through the Tamil Nadu Credit Guarantee Scheme. Launched 19 April 2025 by the MSME Department.
conditions: Age above 35 years with at least 5 years of experience in one of the 25 listed trades.
Must not have received a Tamil Nadu government self-employment subsidy above Rs 1.5 lakh in the last 5 years.
Apply online on the TN MSME portal (KKT); DIC verifies and forwards to the bank.
items.onlyText: Only for artisans aged over 35 with 5+ years in one of 25 listed traditional trades

items.name: Tamil Nadu Women Entrepreneur Empowerment Scheme (TWEES)
items.summary: Bank loan up to Rs 10 lakh for women with 25% subsidy capped at Rs 2 lakh, plus training
details: Announced 26 Nov 2025 by the TN MSME Department; aims to create one lakh women entrepreneurs in five years.
Subsidy of 25% (maximum Rs 2 lakh); promoter contribution 5%; mandatory EDII entrepreneurship training before disbursement.
Covers manufacturing, service and business activities; direct agriculture is excluded.
items.extraFor: Priority to SC/ST, transgender persons, persons with disabilities, widows and BPL families
conditions: Women or transgender persons domiciled in Tamil Nadu, aged 18 to 55; one member per family.
New enterprises only.
Apply online on the TN MSME portal (TWEES); DIC interview, then bank sanction.
items.onlyText: Only for women and transgender persons aged 18 to 55 domiciled in Tamil Nadu

items.name: TANSEED (Tamil Nadu Startup Seed Grant Fund), StartupTN
items.summary: Equity-linked seed grant of up to Rs 10 lakh, or up to Rs 15 lakh for green-tech, rural-impact and women-led startups
details: Run by StartupTN in periodic rounds; funds prototype, market-ready product or pilot production.
25% of the fund is earmarked for women-led startups and 10% for rural-impact startups.
TANSEED 8.0 took applications from 6 to 20 Dec 2025; watch StartupTN for the next round.
items.extraFor: Higher cap (Rs 15 lakh) for women-led, rural-impact and green-tech startups
conditions: Startup headquartered in Tamil Nadu, registered with StartupTN and recognised by DPIIT.
Not formed by splitting an existing business; not a subsidiary or JV or Indian arm of a foreign firm.
Apply online at startuptn.in when a round is open.
items.onlyText: Only for DPIIT-recognised startups registered with StartupTN

items.name: Capital Investment Subsidy Scheme for Advanced Fabric Formation Machinery
items.summary: 20% capital subsidy, up to Rs 1 crore per unit, on new advanced weaving/knitting machinery; 75% of budget reserved for MSMEs
details: 20% of the cost of new advanced fabric formation machinery, capped at Rs 1 crore per unit.
Annual budget Rs 30 crore, 75% earmarked for MSMEs; first-come, first-served.
Issued under G.O.(Ms) No.52 dated 4 Mar 2026.
conditions: Registered textile unit in Tamil Nadu with GST and valid licences; new units and existing units modernising or expanding.
Only brand-new machinery from manufacturers or authorised agents; second-hand machinery not eligible.
Apply online on the TN Textiles schemes portal.

items.name: Special Scheme in the Spinning Sector (technology upgradation, 6% interest subvention)
items.summary: 6% interest subvention for 5 years (incl. 2-year moratorium) on loans to replace 15+ year-old spinning machinery
details: State refunds 6% of interest charged on technology-upgradation term loans for 5 years, including a 2-year moratorium.
Scheme period 2024 to 2033; one-time benefit per mill.
conditions: Ring, open-end or airjet spinning mills in Tamil Nadu registered as a company or partnership.
Machinery being replaced must be at least 15 years old; new machinery must be approved by the Technical Evaluation and Monitoring Committee; no second-hand machinery.
Units that availed other state subsidies are not eligible.
Apply online on the TN Textiles schemes portal.

items.onlyText: Only for Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe applicants
items.name: TAHDCO CM-ARISE / Vetri Thozhil Munaivor start-up subsidy for SC/ST entrepreneurs
items.summary: 35% front-end subsidy up to ₹3.5 lakh on a bank loan, plus 6% interest subsidy, for SC/ST entrepreneurs
details: Run by Tamil Nadu Adi Dravidar Housing and Development Corporation (TAHDCO); individuals and self-help groups can apply, for any trade.
District TAHDCO pages list a 6% interest subsidy for first-generation SC/ST entrepreneurs under this subsidy.
TAHDCO also gives SC women SHGs (12 members) a 50% subsidy up to ₹6 lakh under its Economic Development Scheme.
conditions: SC or ST applicant aged 18 to 55, family income up to ₹3 lakh a year, with experience in the chosen trade.
Applicant and family must not have taken an earlier government subsidy; assets must be in the applicant's name.
Apply online on the TAHDCO scheme portal.

items.onlyText: Only for Backward Class, Most Backward Class and Denotified Community applicants in Tamil Nadu
items.name: TABCEDCO Individual Loan Scheme (backward classes, MBC and denotified communities)
items.summary: Term loans up to ₹25 lakh at 7% to 8% for small businesses and trades
details: 7% up to ₹1.25 lakh; 8% from ₹1.25 lakh to ₹25 lakh. Repayment 6 to 24 quarters by loan size.
Funded 85% by NBCFDC, 10% by TABCEDCO and 5% by the borrower.
A Group Loan Scheme gives SHGs (60% BC/MBC/DNC members) up to ₹1.25 lakh per member and ₹15 lakh per group at 6%.
conditions: Backward Class, Most Backward Class or Denotified Community applicant from an economically weaker section.
Register and apply online on the TABCEDCO portal, or submit the offline form.

items.onlyText: Only for first-generation entrepreneurs financed under NEEDS
items.name: TIIC 3% interest subvention on NEEDS loans
items.summary: 3% interest subvention on TIIC loans for NEEDS first-generation entrepreneurs, up to ₹30 lakh per unit
details: Offered by Tamil Nadu Industrial Investment Corporation (TIIC) on top of the NEEDS 25% capital subsidy.
Applies to standard-category TIIC borrowers.
conditions: Unit sanctioned under NEEDS and financed by TIIC.
Apply at a TIIC branch office.

items.name: EMD exemption for Tamil Nadu MSEs in state tenders (G.O.Ms.No.199, 2022)
items.summary: Tamil Nadu micro and small units need not pay EMD in state government tenders for items they make
details: G.O.Ms.No.199, Finance (Salaries) Department, 27 Jun 2022, under the Tamil Nadu Transparency in Tenders Rules 2000.
Covers tenders of government departments, state PSUs, boards, local bodies, co-operatives, universities and government societies.
The Transparency in Tenders Rules also allow up to 25% of a divisible order to a domestic enterprise that matches the lowest price (G.O.(Ms) No.207, 2018).
conditions: Micro or small enterprise located in Tamil Nadu, for items it manufactures.
Produce Udyam Registration Certificate; give an undertaking to pay a penalty if contract terms are breached; the buyer may inspect the unit.

items.name: Free and subsidised electricity for powerloom weavers (Tamil Nadu)
items.summary: First 1,000 units every two months free for powerloom weavers; units beyond that billed at subsidised tariff
details: Free units raised from 750 to 1,000 bimonthly from 3 March 2023.
About 1.63 lakh powerloom weavers benefited in 2023-24 (Rs 496 crore); 2024-25 budget Rs 563 crore.
conditions: Powerloom weaver with a powerloom service connection in Tamil Nadu.
Apply through TANGEDCO/TNPDCL with the Assistant Director of Handlooms and Textiles certificate.
items.onlyText: Only for powerloom weavers
apply: Tamil Nadu Department of Handlooms and Textiles

items.name: Free electricity for handloom weavers (Tamil Nadu)
items.summary: 300 units of free electricity every two months for handloom weavers
details: Raised from 200 to 300 units bimonthly from 3 March 2023; about 75,000 weavers covered in 2023-24.
conditions: Handloom weaver in Tamil Nadu with a domestic service connection used for weaving.
Apply through the Assistant Director of Handlooms and Textiles of the district.
items.onlyText: Only for handloom weavers
apply: Tamil Nadu Department of Handlooms and Textiles

items.name: Electronic panel board subsidy for powerlooms (Tamil Nadu)
items.summary: 50% government subsidy on electronic panel boards fitted to plain powerlooms
details: Funded from the Powerloom Registration Fund; about 5,000 powerlooms fitted so far.
Panel boards cut power use and improve fabric quality.
conditions: Registered powerloom unit in Tamil Nadu.
Apply to the Assistant Director of Handlooms and Textiles of the district.
items.onlyText: Only for powerloom units
apply: Tamil Nadu Department of Handlooms and Textiles

items.name: Handloom Support Programme (Tamil Nadu state scheme)
items.summary: 90% state share on loom technology upgradation; 100% for design, product diversification and working capital; 75 to 80% for market and brand promotion
details: Seven components: technology upgradation (90:10), design development, product diversification, working capital and R&D (100% government), brand promotion (80:20) and market expansion (75:25).
2024-25 budget Rs 20 crore.
conditions: Handloom weavers and primary handloom weavers' co-operative societies in Tamil Nadu.
Apply through the Assistant Director of Handlooms and Textiles of the district.
items.onlyText: Only for handloom weavers and their co-operative societies
apply: Tamil Nadu Department of Handlooms and Textiles

items.name: Tamil Nadu Tourism Policy 2023: capital subsidy for tourism projects
items.summary: 25% capital subsidy up to Rs 1.5 crore for tourism projects up to Rs 50 crore, plus extra 10% (up to Rs 5 lakh) for micro enterprises
details: Category A (investment up to Rs 50 crore): 25% capital subsidy up to Rs 1.5 crore; extra 5% (up to Rs 25 lakh) for expansion; extra 10% (up to Rs 5 lakh) for micro enterprises.
Wage incentive of Rs 24,000 per employee per year for up to 3 years for units employing more than 20 people.
Interest subsidy for micro, new and expansion projects and certification support (amounts not confirmed).
Eligible types include heritage hotels, eco-huts, tented camps, caravan tourism and adventure tourism projects.
items.extraFor: Extra 5% capital subsidy (up to Rs 5 lakh) for SC/ST, women, transgender and differently-abled entrepreneurs
conditions: Tourism has industry status, so industrial concessions also apply
Apply through the Tamil Nadu Tourism Department single window

items.name: Value addition machinery subsidy (TN Agricultural Engineering Department)
items.summary: 40% subsidy on farm-produce processing machines such as mini dal mills, millet mills, oil expellers and packing machines
details: Covers machines such as mini dhall mills, millet mills, oil expellers, packing machines, groundnut decorticators, polishers and cleaner-cum-graders.
Subsidy is 40% of cost or the prescribed ceiling, whichever is less.
items.extraFor: Additional 20% for SC/ST small and marginal farmers
conditions: Open to entrepreneurs, farmers, FPOs, SHGs and user groups in all districts except Chennai.
Apply to the Assistant Executive Engineer (Agricultural Engineering) of the district.

items.name: Agri-Tech Grant for start-ups (TN Department of Agricultural Marketing and Agri Business)
items.summary: Grant up to ₹10 lakh for early-stage and up to ₹25 lakh for scaling agri, livestock and fisheries start-ups
details: Up to ₹10 lakh for new start-ups and up to ₹25 lakh for existing start-ups expanding and marketing their products.
Supports value addition, shelf-life extension of farm produce and new farm machinery; ready-to-eat food products are not covered.
conditions: Must be a company or LLP registered with StartupTN or Startup India, with average profit under ₹5 lakh over the last three years.
Rounds are called periodically; apply through the district Deputy Director of Agriculture (Agri Business) office.
items.onlyText: Only for registered agri start-ups (company or LLP)
apply: Agricultural Marketing and Agri Business Department, TN

items.name: Tamil Nadu public procurement relaxations for startups (Startup and Innovation Policy 2023)
items.summary: Startups exempt from EMD, prior turnover and experience, with tender-cost waiver, for buys below Rs 20 lakh
details: Exemption from EMD, prior turnover and prior experience, and waiver of tender cost, for procurement below Rs 20 lakh.
conditions: Startup registered with StartupTN.
Claim the exemption in the tender of the Tamil Nadu department or body.

items.name: Tamil Nadu SC/ST Startup Fund (StartupTN)
items.summary: About Rs 50 crore fund for equity and debt support to startups majority-owned by SC/ST founders
details: Equity and debt support to startups owned mostly by SC/ST entrepreneurs, from a budget of about Rs 50 crore announced in 2022.
conditions: Startup registered with StartupTN and majority-owned by SC/ST founders.
Apply through StartupTN during calls.
items.onlyText: Only for startups majority-owned by SC/ST entrepreneurs

items.name: Tamil Nadu free first-year incubation for women-led startups
items.summary: Free rent and membership for one year at state-supported incubators, subsidy up to Rs 2 lakh
details: Women-led startups get free rent and membership for the first year at state-supported and state-funded university incubators, up to Rs 2 lakh.
conditions: Women-led startup registered with StartupTN.
Apply to a state-supported incubator.
items.onlyText: Only for women-led startups

states.statusText: In force (G.O.Ms.No.16, 18 Sep 2024). The official text is a scanned image, so every figure below comes from a consultancy summary; check them with the DIC.

portal.label: TG-iPASS (claim within 6 months of commercial production)

states.zones: No location zones; rates vary with the owner's category (general, women, SC/ST or PwD) and the unit's size.
states.notes: The 2014 T-IDEA and T-PRIDE (for SC/ST) schemes were the base for these incentives.

items.name: Capital investment subsidy
items.summary: 25% of fixed capital investment, up to ₹30 lakh, for general-category micro and small units.
details: Medium enterprises are not eligible.
items.extraFor: Women: +20% (total cap ₹50L). SC/ST/PwD: 50% ≤₹1 Cr (manufacturing), 35% ≤₹75L (services); SC/ST/PwD women +20% (total cap ₹1.2 Cr)
conditions: New units, or existing units expanding investment and capacity by ≥25%
Claim within 6 months of commercial production; 6-12 months late means a 50% cut; later is ineligible
General-category negative list includes distilleries, breweries, mining and hotels

items.name: Net SGST reimbursement
items.summary: 100% of net SGST for 5 years (micro/small) or 75% for 7 years (medium), capped at 100% of FCI.
details: SC/ST/PwD units: 100% for 5 years.
items.extraFor: SC/ST/PwD: 100% for 5 years

items.name: Power cost reimbursement
items.summary: ₹1 per unit power cost reimbursement for 5 years (₹1.50 for SC/ST/PwD units).
items.extraFor: SC/ST/PwD: ₹1.50/unit

items.name: Pavala Vaddi interest subsidy
items.summary: Interest above 3% reimbursed, up to 9% a year, for 5 years.

items.name: Stamp duty reimbursement
items.summary: 100% stamp duty reimbursed on land purchase, lease, mortgage and hypothecation deeds.

items.name: Land cost rebate and land conversion fee
items.summary: 25% land cost rebate in TGIIC or private parks, up to ₹10 lakh; 25% of the conversion fee, up to ₹10 lakh.
items.extraFor: SC/ST/PwD: 50% of land cost, up to ₹50L

items.name: Quality, ZED and patent support
items.summary: Quality/ZED certification 50% up to ₹2 lakh; patents 100% up to ₹2 lakh.
items.extraFor: SC/ST/PwD: 100% up to ₹3L

items.name: Rajiv Yuva Vikasam (self-employment subsidy for SC, ST, BC and minority youth)
items.summary: Units up to ₹3 lakh: 80% subsidy up to ₹1 lakh, 70% up to ₹2 lakh, 60% up to ₹3 lakh; rest bank loan
details: Launched March 2025 with a ₹6,000 crore outlay to help about 5 lakh unemployed youth set up self-employment units of ₹1 lakh to ₹3 lakh.
Subsidy share falls as unit cost rises: 80% (₹1 lakh unit), 70% (₹2 lakh), 60% (₹3 lakh); the balance is a bank loan.

Applications (about 16 lakh) were taken in March-April 2025 and are still under verification; the 2026-27 budget provides ₹5,800 crore and first-phase support for ₹1 lakh units was reported to start from 19 Nov 2026.
conditions: Applicant must be an unemployed youth from SC, ST, BC or minority communities in Telangana.
Apply online on the TGOBMMS portal when a window is open, or through district welfare offices / ITDA (for STs); selection by district committees under the Collector.
items.onlyText: Only for unemployed SC, ST, BC and minority youth in Telangana

items.name: T-PRIDE (Telangana State Program for Rapid Incubation of Dalit Entrepreneurs) - SC/ST incentive package
items.summary: SC/ST units: 35% investment subsidy up to ₹75 lakh, 100% net SGST for 5 years, ₹1.50/unit power, interest above 3% reimbursed
details: Investment subsidy of 35% of fixed capital for micro and small units, up to ₹75 lakh; extra 5% for ST units in scheduled areas and extra 10% (up to ₹10 lakh) for SC/ST women.
Seed capital of 20% of machinery cost for first-generation micro units (adjusted against investment subsidy).
100% stamp duty and transfer duty reimbursement; land cost rebate of 33.3% up to ₹10 lakh in industrial estates; 25% of land conversion charges up to ₹10 lakh.
Power cost reimbursement of ₹1.50 per unit for 5 years; Pavala Vaddi interest subsidy on interest above 3% (up to 9%) for 5 years for micro and small units, including services.
Net SGST reimbursement: 100% for 5 years (micro and small), 75% for 7 years (medium); 100% of quality certification or patent cost up to ₹3 lakh.
items.extraFor: ST units in scheduled areas get an extra 5%; SC/ST women get an extra 10% investment subsidy (up to ₹10 lakh).
conditions: Enterprise must be 100% owned by SC or ST entrepreneur(s) and registered on Udyam.
Apply through TS-iPASS / the Industries Department incentive portal after commercial production; appraisal by the District Industries Centre or state committee.
items.onlyText: Only for enterprises wholly owned by SC or ST entrepreneurs

items.name: Indira Mahila Shakti - interest-free bank loans for women SHGs (Vaddi Leni Runalu)
items.summary: State pays the full interest on bank loans up to ₹10 lakh taken by eligible women SHGs (raised from ₹5 lakh in May 2026)
details: Announced 7 May 2026 at the release of the 2026-27 Annual Credit Plan: the interest-free loan limit for women self-help groups rises from ₹5 lakh to ₹10 lakh.
2026-27 bank credit target for women's groups is ₹26,621 crore; under Indira Mahila Shakti the state also links SHGs to enterprises such as rice mills, godowns, solar plants and bus leasing.
conditions: Only for eligible women SHGs under SERP (rural) or MEPMA (urban) with prompt repayment.
Apply through the SHG's village organisation / bank branch.
items.onlyText: Only for women self-help groups in Telangana
apply: Through SHG federation and bank branch

items.name: SERP Telangana Challenge Fund and Incubator Programme for women-led rural enterprises
items.summary: Rs 12.66 crore challenge fund with incubation, mentoring and grant or loan linkage for about 300 women- and youth-led rural enterprises
details: Run by SERP (Society for Elimination of Rural Poverty) with T-Hub, WE Hub and BITS Pilani Hyderabad TBI; applications opened 8 March 2026.
Covers food processing, handicrafts and handlooms, services, manufacturing and rural technology; per-enterprise grant amount not confirmed.
conditions: Rural women entrepreneurs, SHG members and federations, and women-SHG-led micro and small enterprises in Telangana.
Apply through the online form on the BITS Pilani Hyderabad TBI SERP project page.
items.onlyText: Only for rural women- or youth-led enterprises, mainly from SHG networks
apply: SERP incubator application (TBI BITS Pilani Hyderabad)

items.name: WE Hub RAMP Women Acceleration Programme
items.summary: Free acceleration support for women-led MSMEs: training, mentoring, finance linkages and market access to Mar 2027
details: Run by WE Hub (Government of Telangana) under the World Bank-assisted RAMP programme with the Union MSME Ministry.
First cohort of 45 women-led MSMEs from 13 districts selected from 300 applicants (Sep 2025).
Support includes capacity building, sector mentors, financial linkages, e-commerce and B2B/B2C market connections; runs until March 2027.
conditions: Women-led micro, small or medium enterprise in Telangana.
Selection through WE Hub district outreach boot-camps and cohort calls.
items.onlyText: Only for women-led enterprises

items.name: Telangana Tourism Policy 2025-30: net SGST reimbursement for tourism projects
items.summary: Net SGST reimbursed for tourism projects based on investment size and location (reported 50% for 5 years)
details: Net State GST is reimbursed to investors based on project investment size and location; news reports put it at 50% for 5 years.
Focus segments: eco, medical, spiritual, MICE and sports tourism. Exact slabs not confirmed.
conditions: Policy tabled in the Telangana Assembly in December 2024 for 2025-2030
Apply to Telangana Tourism Department

items.name: Telangana public procurement relaxations for startups (G.O.Ms.No.08, 28 Apr 2018)
items.summary: Startups get EMD exemption, no prior turnover/experience need, and 15% relief on quoted bids
details: No prior turnover or experience is required of startups in state tenders.
Exemption from earnest money deposit.
15% financial relief on quoted bids, and relaxed turnover, manpower and ISO certification requirements.
conditions: Recognised startup based in Telangana.
Claim the relaxations in tenders of Telangana departments and PSUs.

states.short: Tripura Industrial Investment Promotion Incentive Scheme 2022
states.statusText: In force until 31 Mar 2027.

portal.label: Department of Industries and Commerce (Eligibility Certificate from the DIC)

states.zones: No location zones; thrust sectors (rubber, bamboo, agri-horticulture, tea, agar, tourism, hospitals, waste processing and others) get higher rates.
states.notes: Operating subsidies need an Eligibility Certificate from the DIC.

items.name: State Capital Investment Subsidy
items.summary: 30% of fixed capital investment up to Rs 1 crore; thrust sectors 40% up to Rs 1.25 crore.
details: New MSMEs and substantial expansion of existing units: non-thrust 30% (cap Rs 100 lakh); thrust sector 40% (cap Rs 125 lakh).
SC/ST/PH/women enterprises: additional 5%, caps unchanged.
Same rates for micro, small and medium.
items.extraFor: +5% for SC, ST, physically handicapped and women enterprises (caps Rs 100/125 lakh unchanged)
conditions: Eligibility Certificate from DIC
Production/expansion within 01-04-2022 to 31-03-2027
Fixed-capital definition, expansion threshold and negative list unconfirmed

items.name: Industrial Promotion Subsidy (GST reimbursement)
items.summary: 100% of net GST paid reimbursed for 5 years; cap Rs 80 lakh/yr (non-thrust), Rs 125 lakh/yr (thrust).
details: 100% of net GST (net of input tax) actually paid, 5 years; annual cap Rs 80 lakh non-thrust / Rs 125 lakh thrust; aggregate up to 150% of plant & machinery investment.
Years 6-10 (continuing units): 25% of net GST.
conditions: 2022 news reports describe it as 100% SGST reimbursement - confirm tax base
Aggregate cap 150% of plant & machinery investment

items.name: Power charges subsidy
items.summary: Units above 20 HP get power at Rs 5.00/unit without ceiling; up to 20 HP get 25% reimbursement.
details: Connected load above 20 HP: power charges @ Rs 5.00 per unit, no upper ceiling (reads as a concessional tariff).
Up to 20 HP: 25% of actual charges, cap Rs 15 lakh/yr (non-thrust) or Rs 25 lakh/yr (thrust).
5 years; 5 more years for continuing units.
conditions: Mechanism of the Rs 5.00/unit benefit (tariff vs rebate) unconfirmed

items.name: Partial reimbursement of interest on term loans
items.summary: Term-loan interest reimbursement: 4% (max Rs 5 lakh/yr) non-thrust; 5% (max Rs 12 lakh/yr) thrust.
details: Term loans from banks/financial institutions: reimbursement @4% (non-thrust, cap Rs 5 lakh/yr) or @5% (thrust, cap Rs 12 lakh/yr), 5 years. Whether this means interest-rate points or a share of interest paid is unconfirmed.
conditions: Term loans only

items.name: Employment Cost Subsidy
items.summary: Thrust-sector MSMEs with 20+ Tripura-domicile employees: 100% of employer EPF/ESI reimbursed for 5 years.
details: New thrust-sector MSMEs employing at least 20 State-domicile persons: 100% of employer EPF and ESI contribution for 5 years; 50% for years 6-10 if in continuous operation.
conditions: Thrust sector only
At least 20 employees domiciled in Tripura

items.name: Certification, technology transfer, ZED and CGTMSE fee reimbursement
items.summary: 100% of certification fees and technology-transfer cost; ZED bonus Rs 2-10 lakh; CGTMSE fees reimbursed.
details: Standard certifications (12 areas) and renewals: 100% of fees.
Technical know-how/technology transfer: one-time 100%.
ZED-certified Udyam MSMEs: Rs 2 lakh (P&M up to Rs 1 crore), Rs 5 lakh (Rs 1-10 crore), Rs 10 lakh (above Rs 10 crore).
Micro and small: 100% of CGTMSE guarantee and annual service fees.
conditions: ZED bonus needs Udyam registration and MoMSME ZED certificate
CGTMSE reimbursement for micro and small only

items.name: Procurement preference, trade fair and export subsidy
items.summary: 15% purchase preference and EMD exemption; trade fairs 50% (Rs 1 lakh/event); Bangladesh exports 10%.
details: State tenders: 15% price preference and 100% EMD/bid-security exemption for local manufacturers with at least 20% in-State value addition.
Trade fairs: 50% of travel (1 person) and goods transport, up to Rs 1 lakh/event, 2 per year.
Exports to Bangladesh via land customs stations: 10% of value, max Rs 50 lakh/yr.
conditions: At least 20% value addition in Tripura
Local service entrepreneurs (excluding works contract, IT/ITeS) eligible for the capital subsidy also get EMD exemption

items.name: State Transport Subsidy
items.summary: 50% of transport cost of secondary raw materials for local-resource-based and packaging units.
details: Local-resource-based industries and packaging-material manufacturers: 50% of cost of transporting secondary raw materials from outside Tripura, at railway standard parcel rates.
conditions: Only local-resource-based or packaging-material units

items.name: Swavalamban (Self-employment Generation Programme)
items.summary: Bank loan up to ₹1 crore with 30% subsidy (35% for women), subsidy capped at ₹1 lakh
details: State self-employment scheme run by the Industries & Commerce Department through the District Industries Centres; revised guidelines from 2019-20.
Covers manufacturing, service and small trade/business activities; applications are sponsored to banks.
items.extraFor: Women get 35% subsidy instead of 30% (same ₹1 lakh cap)
conditions: Age 18 to 50; one person per family; no income or education bar
Individuals, partnership firms, SHGs and co-operatives can apply
Apply online on the Swavalamban portal; DIC sponsors the case to the bank
items.onlyText: Only for applicants aged 18 to 50 (one per family)

items.name: Tripura Start-Up Policy 2024
items.summary: ₹2 lakh seed grant, ₹20,000/month operating cost for 1 year, prototype support up to ₹10 lakh, marketing up to ₹5 lakh
details: Tri-Seed one-time grant of ₹2 lakh after recognition.
Operational cost reimbursement of ₹20,000 per month for up to one year.
Prototype support up to ₹10 lakh after proof-of-concept approval; marketing support up to ₹5 lakh after commercialisation.
Patent reimbursement up to ₹2 lakh (Indian) and ₹10 lakh (foreign) for incubated startups; procurement relaxations (EMD, turnover, experience).
items.extraFor: Women-led startups get 10% extra and startups led by persons with disabilities get 20% extra on operating and prototype support
conditions: Pvt Ltd, LLP or registered partnership, under 10 years old, turnover up to ₹25 crore
Registered office and operations in Tripura; at least 50% of skilled staff from Tripura
Apply for recognition on the state Start-Up portal (Directorate of IT); claims through the portal
items.onlyText: Only for startups recognised under the Tripura Start-Up Policy (under 10 years old)

items.name: Paryatan Sahayak Prakalp (Tripura Tourism Policy 2020-25)
items.summary: Interest on tourism loans up to Rs 5 lakh reimbursed (at 8% or actual rate, whichever is lower) for 5 years
details: Covers homestays, wayside amenities, boats, water and adventure sports, heritage and eco-tourism, wellness and eco-friendly transport projects.
Interest is reimbursed every 6 months to regular repayers; borrower puts in 5% margin.
Tourism projects can also claim incentives under the Tripura Industrial Investment Promotion Incentive Scheme.
conditions: Individuals aged 18 to 50; one person per family; preference to unemployed youth and hotel-management or tourism graduates.
Project must start within 3 months of loan and earn income within a year; support stops if the loan turns NPA.
Apply on the Tripura Tourism portal; a committee reviews applications monthly. The 2020-25 policy period has ended, so check whether it has been extended.
items.onlyText: Only for individuals aged 18 to 50

states.statusText: In force for five years from 28 Sep 2022, or until a new policy.

portal.label: Nivesh Mitra single window

states.zones: Bundelkhand and Purvanchal get the highest rates, Madhyanchal and Paschimanchal lower ones. Gautam Buddh Nagar and Ghaziabad get the lowest stamp-duty tier.
states.notes: Covers manufacturing and manufacturing-related services only; trading and general services get none of its incentives. There is no SGST or electricity-duty incentive. ODOP projects can get a separate margin-money grant.

items.name: Investment Promotion Assistance (capital subsidy)
items.summary: Capital subsidy of 10–25% on plant, machinery and building investment, by region and size; max ₹4 crore per unit.
details: Bundelkhand & Purvanchal: micro 25%, small 20%, medium 15%. Madhyanchal & Paschimanchal: 20%, 15%, 10%. The policy does not exclude Gautam Buddh Nagar/Ghaziabad (a secondary source applies 20/15/10).
Land excluded. Paid in two equal instalments: at building completion, then at ≥50% commercial production.
items.extraFor: SC/ST and women-owned units (≥51% ownership): +2 percentage points
conditions: Trading excluded; services qualify only if manufacturing-related (e.g. CETP, CFC)
Negative list: tobacco/gutkha/pan masala, alcohol/aerated drinks, firecrackers, plastic bags <40 micron
Expansion/diversification qualifies if gross block and capacity each rise ≥25%
Investment must be completed and production started within 2 yrs (micro), 3 yrs (small) or 4 yrs (medium) of application

items.name: Capital interest subsidy (micro enterprises)
items.summary: New micro units get 50% of loan interest reimbursed over 5 years, up to ₹25 lakh per unit.
details: Paid yearly after that year's interest is fully paid; ceiling of ₹25 lakh per unit across 5 years; land cost excluded.
items.extraFor: SC/ST and women-owned units: 60% of interest (same ₹25 lakh ceiling)
conditions: Micro enterprises only
Same trading, services and negative-list limits as the capital subsidy

items.name: Stamp duty exemption
items.summary: Stamp duty exemption of 100% in Purvanchal/Bundelkhand, 75% in Madhyanchal/Paschimanchal, 50% in Gautam Buddh Nagar/Ghaziabad.
details: Applies to MSMEs being set up (and qualifying expansions). MSME industrial-park developers get 100% in all regions.
items.extraFor: Women entrepreneurs: 100% exemption anywhere in UP
conditions: The 75% Madhyanchal/Paschimanchal rate excludes Gautam Buddh Nagar and Ghaziabad (50%)

items.name: EPF reimbursement
items.summary: 100% of the employer's EPF contribution reimbursed for 5 years from start of production.
details: Clause 5.4.1: the full employer EPF share for 5 years; the policy states no ceiling.
conditions: New units; expansions under clause 5.8.2 terms

items.name: Quality certification, testing lab and patent/GI assistance
items.summary: Certification and testing-lab costs reimbursed 75%/50%/25% (micro/small/medium), max ₹5 lakh; patents 75%, max ₹10 lakh.
details: Same shares for IT systems (max ₹2 lakh) and mandatory professional training (max ₹0.5 lakh).
Patent/GI documentation 75% (max ₹10 lakh) plus attorney fees of ₹50,000 national / ₹2 lakh international; ERP 75% (max ₹1 lakh); ICT 75% (max ₹5 lakh).
conditions: Open to existing and new MSMEs

items.name: CGTMSE guarantee fee and SME-exchange listing support
items.summary: The state pays the one-time CGTMSE guarantee fee on collateral-free bank loans up to ₹2 crore.
details: Also reimburses 20% of the cost of raising equity on a stock exchange (max ₹5 lakh), for any MSME size.
conditions: Loans must be covered by CGTMSE

items.name: Mukhyamantri Yuva Udyami Vikas Abhiyan (CM-YUVA), separate state scheme
items.summary: Youth aged 21–40: interest-free bank loans up to ₹5 lakh, plus a 10% capital subsidy (max ₹50,000).
details: The UP MSME portal lists phase 1 as loans up to ₹5 lakh with 100% interest subsidy for 4 years, and phase 2 as ₹10–20 lakh with 50% for 3 years.
Requires 8th pass, a skill certificate from a state scheme, and UP residence.
conditions: New enterprises only
Trading eligibility unconfirmed
Not part of MSME Policy 2022

items.name: ODOP Financing for Project Cost (ODOP Margin Money Scheme)
items.summary: Margin money subsidy: 25% (max ₹6.25 lakh) up to ₹25 lakh project cost, down to 10% (max ₹20 lakh) above ₹1.5 crore
details: Project cost up to ₹25 lakh: 25% or ₹6.25 lakh, whichever is less.
₹25-50 lakh: 20% or ₹6.25 lakh, whichever is higher; ₹50-150 lakh: 10% or ₹10 lakh, whichever is higher; above ₹150 lakh: 10% or ₹20 lakh, whichever is less.
Balance is financed by a bank loan; own contribution 10% (5% for SC/ST/OBC, minority, women, ex-servicemen, divyang).
items.extraFor: Own contribution cut to 5% for SC/ST/OBC, minority, women, ex-servicemen and divyang applicants
conditions: Applicant 18+; no minimum education; not a bank defaulter.
Unit must make or deal in the ODOP product notified for its district.
Not for those who already took PMEGP, PMRY, CM Yuva Swarozgar or similar self-employment subsidy.
Apply online on the DI UP portal; bank sanction needed.
items.onlyText: Only units making the district's ODOP product

items.name: Mukhyamantri Gramodyog Rozgar Yojana (UP Khadi and Village Industries Board)
items.summary: Bank loans up to ₹10 lakh for rural units; interest above 4% subsidised, fully interest-free for reserved categories
details: General category: state pays interest above 4%.
SC, ST, OBC, minority, women, divyang and ex-servicemen: full interest subsidy as per rules.
Loans from nationalised banks and regional rural banks.
items.extraFor: Full interest subsidy for SC/ST/OBC, minority, women, divyang and ex-servicemen
conditions: Rural resident of UP aged 18 to 50; unit must be set up in a rural area.
Village-industry activity; priority to ITI/polytechnic-trained youth.
Apply online on the scheme e-portal; district Khadi and Village Industries office processes the case.
items.onlyText: Only rural residents aged 18 to 50 setting up a village-industry unit in a rural area

items.name: Vishwakarma Shram Samman Yojana
items.summary: Free 6-day skill training plus a modern toolkit for traditional artisans
details: Six days of free skill-upgrade training.
Advanced trade toolkit given after training.
Covers trades such as carpentry, tailoring, basket weaving, barbering, goldsmith, blacksmith, pottery, confectionery, cobbler and handicrafts.
conditions: UP native aged 18+, working in a traditional craft.
No toolkit received in the last two years; one member per family.
Non-traditional-caste applicants need a certificate of craft association from the local body.
Apply online on the DI UP portal.
items.onlyText: Only traditional artisans and craft workers

items.name: One District One Cuisine (ODOC) Scheme - Ek Jila Ek Vyanjan
items.summary: Margin money 25% (max ₹6.25 lakh) up to ₹25 lakh project, up to 10% (max ₹50 lakh) above ₹1.5 crore, for district food products
details: Margin money by project cost: up to ₹25 lakh, 25% (max ₹6.25 lakh); ₹25-50 lakh, 20% or ₹6.25 lakh whichever is higher; ₹50-150 lakh, 10% or ₹10 lakh whichever is higher; above ₹150 lakh, 10% (max ₹50 lakh).
Margin money is held as a TDR and adjusted against the bank loan after 2 years of successful operation; land cost is excluded.
Marketing support of 75% of stall fee, freight and travel for fairs in India and abroad, plus certification, GI, FSSAI, packaging and website costs, up to ₹10 lakh a year.
Free training in food safety, hygiene and product development (FSSAI, CFTRI, NIFTEM and others).
Notified by GO dated 5 May 2026 (MSME and Export Promotion Department); covers new units, expansion and diversification.
items.extraFor: Own contribution cut to 5% (from 10%) for SC, ST, OBC, minority, women and divyang applicants
conditions: Applicant aged 18+; no education bar; not a bank defaulter.
Unit must make the traditional food product (ODOC) identified for its district.
Not for those who already took a similar central or UP self-employment scheme; one benefit per family.
Apply online on the UP MSME department portal; bank loan and one-week training required.
items.onlyText: Only units making their district's notified ODOC food product

items.name: UP Micro and Small Industries Technical Upgradation Scheme (RAMP UP TUS)
items.summary: 50% subsidy on new machinery (max ₹5 lakh) plus 50% interest subsidy (max ₹1 lakh a year, 5 years); total cap ₹7.5 lakh micro, ₹15 lakh small
details: 50% of capital spend on advanced plant and machinery, up to ₹5 lakh.
50% of interest on the machinery loan, up to ₹1 lakh a year for up to 5 years.
50% support (up to ₹1 lakh each) for ERP, consultancy/DPR and branding; 50% of trademark/copyright fees up to ₹2 lakh; support for BIS, FSSAI and quality certification.
Support for replacing old DG sets with CAQM-compliant generators in NCR districts.
RAMP adds 15% over the state scheme; green technology, solar and women-owned units get preference.
items.extraFor: Preference for women-owned units
conditions: Micro and small units in UP running for at least 3 years.
Not already assisted under the UP Industrial Investment and Employment Promotion Policy 2017 or another state or central scheme.
Unit must repay support if it closes within 5 years.
Apply online to the District Industries and Enterprise Promotion Centre; first come, first served; district and state committees approve.

items.name: Mukhyamantri Sookshm Udyamee Durghatana Beema Yojana (micro entrepreneur accident insurance)
items.summary: Free accident cover of ₹5 lakh for micro-entrepreneurs (death or permanent disability)
details: ₹5 lakh to the nominee on accidental death, and ₹5 lakh for permanent disability; partial disability paid by the percentage certified by the CMO.
Paid by DBT within a month after the district Deputy Commissioner of Industries recommends the claim.
conditions: Micro-entrepreneur in UP aged 18 to 60.
Not covered under the GST Department's trader accident insurance scheme.
Register on the DI UP MSME portal; the family applies online for a claim.

items.name: UP Startup Policy 2020 (amended 2022) incentives
items.summary: Sustenance allowance ₹17,500 a month for a year, prototype grant up to ₹5 lakh and launch support up to ₹7.5 lakh
details: Sustenance allowance of ₹17,500 per month for one year.
Prototype grant up to ₹5 lakh; seed capital / marketing assistance for launching the product up to ₹7.5 lakh.
Patent filing reimbursement up to ₹2 lakh (Indian) and ₹10 lakh (international); event participation up to ₹50,000 national and ₹1 lakh international.
Six months of free incubation at government incubators.
items.extraFor: 50% more sustenance allowance and seed/marketing support for startups founded by women, transgender persons or divyangjan (over 26% holding), or located in Purvanchal or Bundelkhand
conditions: Startup recognised under the UP Startup Policy, usually through a recognised incubator.
Apply through the Startup in UP portal and the host incubator.
items.onlyText: Only for startups recognised under the UP Startup Policy

items.name: ODOP Common Facility Centre (CFC) Promotion Scheme
items.summary: State grant up to 90% of CFC project cost (cost counted up to Rs 15 crore) for ODOP producer groups
details: Funds shared facilities for the district's ODOP product: testing lab, design and training centre, raw material bank, common production or processing centre, packaging, labelling and barcoding, display-cum-sale centre and logistics centre.
For projects up to Rs 15 crore the state gives up to 90%; the SPV bears at least 10%. Above Rs 15 crore, assistance is worked out on Rs 15 crore only.
conditions: Applicant must be a legally registered group (co-operative, producer company, SHG or other legal entity) of units making the district's ODOP product
Beneficiaries must contribute their share
Apply on the Directorate of Industries UP MSME portal
items.onlyText: Only for registered groups (co-operative, producer company, SHG, SPV) of ODOP producers
apply: Apply on the Directorate of Industries UP MSME portal

items.name: ODOP Marketing Development Assistance (MDA) Scheme
items.summary: 75% of stall charge (up to Rs 50,000 for fairs in India) and 75% of freight for ODOP products at fairs
details: Covers 75% of stall rent and 75% of material freight for ODOP artisans, weavers, entrepreneurs and exporters at state, inter-state and international fairs, plus travel fare for one person.
Higher stall-rent limits apply for international fairs; check the government order for the exact caps per fair type.
conditions: Must make the ODOP product listed for the district
Age 18 or above
No similar benefit from the Centre or state in the last two years
Apply on the Directorate of Industries UP MSME portal
apply: Apply on the Directorate of Industries UP MSME portal

items.name: Handicraft Marketing Incentive Scheme
items.summary: Rs 10,000 per fair (up to 2 fairs, Rs 20,000 a year) towards stall rent and transport for handicraft artisans
details: Reimburses stall rent and transport of goods when a UP handicraft artisan takes part in fairs and exhibitions.
Total aid Rs 20,000, at Rs 10,000 per fair, for up to two fairs.
conditions: Age 18 or above
Must hold a Handicraft Identity Card
Apply on the Directorate of Industries UP MSME portal
items.onlyText: Only for handicraft artisans holding a Handicraft Identity Card
apply: Apply on the Directorate of Industries UP MSME portal

items.name: ODOP Training and Toolkit Scheme
items.summary: Free 10-day ODOP skill and entrepreneurship training with Rs 200/day honorarium and a free modern toolkit
details: Free, non-residential 10-day craft and entrepreneurship training for workers in the district's ODOP product value chain.
Trainees get Rs 200 a day honorarium and an advanced toolkit after training.
conditions: Age 18 or above
Must be engaged in the district's ODOP product
No similar benefit taken earlier; not a defaulter of a bank or government body
Apply on the Directorate of Industries UP MSME portal
items.onlyText: Only for artisans and workers making the district's ODOP product
apply: Apply on the Directorate of Industries UP MSME portal

items.name: MSME Department Training Schemes for SC/ST and OBC youth
items.summary: Free 4-month trade and entrepreneurship training with a free trade toolkit for SC/ST and OBC youth aged 18 to 45
details: Group training of four months (one month theory, three months practical at field units) in locally needed trades, run by the UP MSME Department.
Trainees get a toolkit for their trade at the end; SC/ST trainees also get an honorarium and transport and food support (amounts not stated).
conditions: Age 18 to 45
Class 8 pass needed for technical trades; no literacy needed for non-technical trades
Apply on the Directorate of Industries UP MSME portal or through the District Industry Promotion and Entrepreneurship Development Centre
items.onlyText: Only for SC/ST and OBC candidates (separate schemes for each)
apply: Apply on the Directorate of Industries UP MSME portal

items.name: Hastshilp Kaushal Vikas Training Scheme (skill training for handicraftsmen)
items.summary: Six-month craft, design and business skills training with a stipend for young handicraft artisans
details: Upgrades skills of traditional artisans in handicraft districts: modern tools, contemporary design, and marketing and business management.
Batches of 10 trainees for six months; trainees get a stipend (amount not confirmed).
items.extraFor: 5-year age relaxation for SC/ST applicants
conditions: Age 18 to 35
Must hold an artisan PAHCHAN card and Aadhaar
Apply on the Directorate of Industries UP MSME portal
items.onlyText: Only for handicraft artisans aged 18 to 35 with a PAHCHAN card
apply: Apply on the Directorate of Industries UP MSME portal

items.name: UP Export Promotion Policy 2025-30: Marketing Development Assistance for MSME exporters
items.summary: 75% of fair stall and airfare, samples, publicity and export certification costs, up to Rs 25 lakh per exporter a year
details: Overseas fairs: 75% of stall charge (up to Rs 3.25 lakh) and 75% of one airfare (up to Rs 1.25 lakh), up to 3 fairs a year. Domestic international-scale fairs: stall up to Rs 75,000 and airfare up to Rs 30,000.

Virtual fairs 75% up to Rs 25,000 each; publicity and digital marketing 75% up to Rs 1 lakh a year; samples to foreign buyers 75% up to Rs 2 lakh a year; export certifications 75% within the overall cap.
conditions: MSME exporter (manufacturer or merchant) registered with the Export Promotion Bureau, UP
Overall cap Rs 25 lakh per exporter per year
Policy runs from notification to end of FY 2030
apply: Register with Export Promotion Bureau UP (details on Invest UP)

items.name: UP Export Promotion Policy 2025-30: Freight assistance (gateway port and air freight)
items.summary: 30% of freight to gateway port (Rs 20,000/TEU, Rs 40,000/FEU, up to Rs 30 lakh a year) and 30% air freight up to Rs 10 lakh
details: Sea freight to gateway port: 30% of charges, up to Rs 20,000 per 20-ft and Rs 40,000 per 40-ft container, capped at Rs 30 lakh per unit a year. Small exporters (average exports up to Rs 5 crore) get Rs 500 per cubic metre for LCL, up to Rs 20,000 a shipment.
Air freight: up to 30% of freight or Rs 150 per kg, whichever is lower, capped at Rs 10 lakh per unit a year, for UP-origin goods from any Indian air cargo complex.
conditions: Exporting unit in UP registered with the Export Promotion Bureau, UP
Claims are filed online with the Bureau, reported to be quarterly
apply: Register with Export Promotion Bureau UP (details on Invest UP)

items.name: UP Export Promotion Policy 2025-30: Export credit insurance, e-commerce onboarding and export growth reward
items.summary: ECGC premium support (30% up to Rs 5 lakh), 75% of first-year e-commerce fees up to Rs 3 lakh, 1% reward on export growth
details: ECGC export credit insurance premium: up to 30%, capped at Rs 5 lakh (the policy FAQ describes 50% up to Rs 2 lakh for small exporters; confirm with the Bureau).
International e-commerce onboarding: 75% of first-year listing, referral, warehousing and logistics fees, up to Rs 3 lakh one-time. Dak Ghar Niryat Kendra postage: 75% up to Rs 1 lakh a year.
Export performance reward: 1% of year-on-year export growth, up to Rs 20 lakh per exporter a year.
conditions: Exporter registered with the Export Promotion Bureau, UP
ECGC support is for MSME exporters
apply: Register with Export Promotion Bureau UP (details on Invest UP)

items.name: UP Textile and Garmenting Policy 2022: capital and interest subsidy
items.summary: 15% capital subsidy on plant and machinery (25% if 50+ workers) and 60% interest subsidy for 7 years
details: Capital subsidy on plant and machinery: 15% for units with fewer than 50 workers, 25% for more than 50; extra 10% in Poorvanchal and Bundelkhand for units with more than 50 workers.

Interest subsidy: 60% of annual interest on plant and machinery loans for 7 years. Also 25% land cost subsidy on government land, 100% stamp duty exemption on government land (75% in Gautam Budh Nagar), 100% electricity duty exemption for 10 years, and 50% of ETP/DG set cost up to Rs 5 crore.
items.extraFor: Silk sector: 20% capital subsidy for SC/ST entrepreneurs (15% for others)
conditions: New textile or garment unit, or expansion with over 25% more fixed capital and at least 25% more capacity
Apply through Nivesh Mitra / Handloom and Textile Department
apply: Apply through Nivesh Mitra (UP single window)

items.name: UP Textile and Garmenting Policy 2022: support for young textile entrepreneurs and designers
items.summary: 75% of project cost for weaving units of IIHT diploma holders (up to Rs 20-60 lakh) and design studios (up to Rs 30 lakh)
details: IIHT diploma holders starting weaving units: 75% of project cost, up to Rs 20 lakh (5-20 handlooms) or Rs 60 lakh (5-10 powerlooms).

Textile or fashion design graduates entering garments or home furnishing: 50% of flatted factory rent for 5 years plus 75% of machinery and infrastructure cost up to Rs 25 lakh. Design studio: 75% up to Rs 30 lakh.
conditions: Must hold the required IIHT diploma or textile/fashion design degree
Apply through the Handloom and Textile Department / Nivesh Mitra
items.onlyText: Only for IIHT diploma holders and textile or fashion design graduates
apply: Apply through Nivesh Mitra (UP single window)

items.name: UP Food Processing Industry Policy 2023: capital subsidy for food processing units
items.summary: 35% capital subsidy on plant, machinery and technical civil work up to Rs 5 crore (expansion up to Rs 1 crore)
details: New units: 35% of plant, machinery and technical civil work, up to Rs 5 crore. Expansion or modernisation: 25% to 35%, up to Rs 1 crore.

Reefer vehicles and mobile pre-cooling vans: interest subsidy for 5 years up to Rs 50 lakh. 100% stamp duty exemption on land for the unit, 50% CLU fee waiver, mandi fee exemptions, and 25% freight subsidy on exports (not to Nepal, Bangladesh, Bhutan).
items.extraFor: Solar power for rural processing units: 90% subsidy for women entrepreneurs (50% for others)
conditions: Food processing unit in UP
Nodal agency: Horticulture and Food Processing Department; apply as per the policy SOP
apply: Apply through Nivesh Mitra (UP single window)

items.name: Mukhyamantri Matikala Rozgar Yojana (UP Matikala Board)
items.summary: Bank loan for pottery and clay units up to Rs 10 lakh project cost with 25% margin money from the state
details: For toys, household pottery, tiles, washbasins, garden pots and decorative clay items.
Entrepreneur pays 5% and the bank lends 95%, repayable over 5 years; government margin money equal to 25% of the capital loan is credited to the loan account.
conditions: UP resident aged 18 or above; literate (Class 8 pass for projects above Rs 5 lakh)
Matikala training or traditional pottery knowledge
Apply online on the Matikala portal; district committee selects by scorecard
items.onlyText: Only for pottery and clay craft (Matikala) entrepreneurs
apply: Apply on the UP Matikala Board portal

items.name: Matikala Tool-Kit Distribution Scheme
items.summary: Free modern pottery toolkits plus 3-day training for Matikala artisans
details: UP Matikala Board gives toolkits free to selected artisans, with three days of training at divisional centres on new techniques and toolkit use.
items.extraFor: Women from traditional artisan families can apply
conditions: UP domicile, age 18 to 55
Traditional Matikala artisan, family member, or holder of a Matikala training certificate
Apply online; district committee selects
items.onlyText: Only for Matikala (pottery) artisans

items.name: Micro Matikala Common Facility Centre Scheme
items.summary: State-funded common shed, kiln, pug mill and moulds for potters' co-operative societies that put in 20%
details: Funds a 1,000 sq ft common shed, power, water and equipment such as mills, pug mills, moulds and a modern kiln.
The society contributes 20% of project cost (Rs 2.5 lakh) as share capital; the rest is state funded.
conditions: Industrial co-operative society of potters registered under the Co-operative Act
At least 2,500 sq ft land for 10 years; a trained Matikala member
Proposal through the regional Village Industries Officer to UP Matikala Board
items.onlyText: Only for registered potters' industrial co-operative societies
apply: Apply on the UP Matikala Board portal

items.name: Pandit Deendayal Gramodyog Rozgar Yojana (interest subsidy on PMEGP loans)
items.summary: State interest subsidy on bank loans of rural PMEGP units in all UP districts
details: UP Khadi and Village Industries Board pays an interest subsidy on the PMEGP loan of rural units, credited to the loan account through the bank (rate not confirmed).
conditions: Rural unit set up under PMEGP and sponsored by DIC, KVIC or UPKVIB
PMEGP loan sanctioned and disbursed
